jobs.title: Clinical Research Associate - Freelance
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Conduct clinical site monitoring visits throughout the study lifecycle, including Site Selection Visits (SSVs), Site Initiation Visits (SIVs), Interim Monitoring Visits (IMVs), and Close-Out Visits (COVs). Ensure investigator sites operate in accordance with clinical study protocols, ICH-GCP guidelines, sponsor requirements, and applicable local regulations. Monitor patient safety, clinical data quality, and study documentation to maintain compliance and support reliable trial outcomes. Manage investigator sites from initiation through close-out, ensuring monitoring activities are completed effectively and in line with study requirements. Build and maintain strong working relationships with investigators, site personnel, and sponsor stakeholders. Support site readiness, patient recruitment activities, and the resolution of operational issues that could affect study progress or timelines. Identify, document, and escalate site-level risks, deviations, and challenges while contributing to risk-based monitoring strategies. Maintain accurate monitoring records and ensure essential study documentation is complete and up to date. Support audit and inspection readiness activities, helping ensure sites meet quality and regulatory expectations. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, Pharmacy, or a related discipline. At least 3 years of independent clinical monitoring experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or Contract Research Organization (CRO) industry. Demonstrated experience monitoring medical device clinical studies. Strong knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines and applicable clinical research regulatory requirements. Proven experience managing clinical trial sites throughout the full study lifecycle, from initiation to close-out. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both German and English, with fluency in both languages required. Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with investigators, site teams, and sponsor stakeholders. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage monitoring activities and resolve issues independently. Nice to Have: Experience with Medical Device Regulation (MDR) submissions. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement within Germany. Freelance contract offering flexibility in how you manage your professional commitments. Opportunity to work on clinical research activities for a global pharmaceutical sponsor. Collaboration with experienced clinical research professionals in an international environment. Opportunities for personal and professional development. Work within a quality-focused culture built around trust, collaboration, flexibility, passion, and sustainability. Opportunity to contribute to clinical research that supports patient safety and advances healthcare.

jobs.title: Head of Content & Brand
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Define, document, and lead the overall editorial strategy, including content themes, positioning, points of view, formats, and channel priorities. Ensure a consistent and recognizable brand voice and visual identity across all content and communications. Build and activate a network of internal and external contributors, including executives, customer advocates, and partners, to broaden the brand's reach and perspectives. Own audience growth as a measurable business objective, setting targets across owned channels and relevant industry or partner ecosystems. Track audience engagement and content performance, translating insights into pipeline-related metrics and collaborating with Go-to-Market (GTM) and Revenue Operations (RevOps) teams on attribution. Lead, coach, and develop a team of three specialists responsible for video content, brand design, and written content, establishing clear priorities, expectations, and accountability. Serve as the primary connection between Brand and GTM, ensuring content supports commercial objectives without compromising editorial consistency. Partner with demand generation and sales teams to deliver landing pages, advertising creative, nurture sequences, and sales enablement materials. Establish regular cross-functional planning and communication routines to maintain alignment, remove blockers, and ensure effective execution. Requirements: Proven experience in a broad, end-to-end content leadership role within a B2B SaaS environment. Demonstrated success building and growing an engaged target audience and turning content performance into measurable business value. Strong ability to develop, communicate, and defend an editorial strategy using data, insights, and clear reasoning. Excellent editorial judgment, with the confidence to maintain a consistent brand voice while partnering effectively with commercial teams and senior leadership. Experience managing and developing content and creative specialists, with strong coaching, prioritization, and decision-making skills. Ability to connect brand and editorial concepts with commercial objectives, including ideal customer profile (ICP) reach, audience quality, engagement, and pipeline contribution. Strong understanding of content distribution and audience development across platforms such as LinkedIn, YouTube, and podcasts. Fluency in English is required; French language skills are considered an asset. Comfortable using AI-powered writing and production tools, content management systems (CMS), social media management platforms, and analytics tools. Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to operate in a distributed, international environment. Benefits: Fully remote work arrangement, with the role open to candidates based in Canada. Full-time employment. Opportunity to lead and develop a team of three content and creative specialists. Strategic ownership of brand positioning, editorial direction, and audience growth. Close collaboration with senior leadership and cross-functional teams across marketing, sales, revenue operations, and customer success. Opportunity to connect creative and editorial work directly to measurable commercial outcomes. International and remote-friendly working environment.

jobs.title: Hands-on Engineering Manager DevOps (GCP/Kubernetes)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Lead the design, development, and operation of core infrastructure supporting engineering teams, including Kubernetes clusters, CI/CD pipelines, databases, edge infrastructure, and observability systems. Guide the migration of on-premises workloads to GCP and GKE, helping modernize legacy architecture and simplify the overall technology stack. Strengthen infrastructure security, reliability, and business continuity practices while reducing operational complexity and ongoing maintenance. Develop platform capabilities and self-service tooling that enable engineering teams to work more independently and efficiently. Partner with other Engineering Managers and product development leaders to understand internal customer needs, scope initiatives, and prioritize platform work. Manage and mentor a team of four engineers, providing technical guidance while working alongside them on code, infrastructure-as-code quality, engineering standards, and best practices. Maintain approximately 50% hands-on technical involvement, balancing implementation and operational responsibilities with team leadership and development. Establish clear quality standards and lead by example in technical decision-making, infrastructure design, and engineering execution. Lead incident response activities, facilitate postmortems, and drive improvements that strengthen system resilience and operational readiness. Organize team training, define SMART goals, conduct performance reviews, and provide regular, specific, constructive feedback. Maintain oversight of engineers’ work and development processes, helping team members improve their technical capabilities, collaboration, and professional skills. Complete an initial onboarding period of approximately two months as a senior engineer, begin management onboarding during the second month, and assume full team leadership at around the 10-week mark. Requirements: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. At least 2 years of mentoring or leadership experience, including at least 1 year leading a team formally or as a technical lead. 7+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or infrastructure engineering. At least 3 years operating production workloads on Kubernetes, preferably Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE). At least 3 years working with a major cloud provider and Infrastructure as Code, with senior-level knowledge of GCP services including IAM, networking, KMS, GKE, Cloud SQL, and Secret Manager. At least 3 years operating at Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level. Practical experience designing, implementing, and operating CI/CD pipelines. Experience with GitOps tools such as FluxCD or ArgoCD. Ability to collaborate directly with engineering teams and management stakeholders to understand requirements, define scope, and prioritize infrastructure initiatives. Experience leading incident response processes and facilitating post-incident reviews and postmortems. Strong technical judgment, problem-solving skills, and the ability to balance long-term platform improvements with immediate operational needs. Effective communication, mentoring, feedback, and people-management skills, with a commitment to developing engineers through practical guidance and continuous learning. Additional experience that would be an advantage: Leading teams through significant infrastructure or architectural migrations. Supporting large-scale consumer platforms. Building and operating systems in regulated environments. Managing self-hosted observability stacks using tools such as Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Grafana, Tempo, and OpenTelemetry. Building internal developer platforms and self-service infrastructure tooling. Supporting deployments of .NET/C# applications. Database operations involving PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, or RabbitMQ. Experience with Istio or other service mesh technologies. Benefits: Annual compensation of €82,000–€140,000, with the final amount determined by skills,

jobs.title: Director, elluminate Business Development
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Develop and execute the business development territory strategy, taking ownership of revenue growth and sales targets for the elluminate platform. Identify, qualify, and secure new business opportunities across pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations through industry networks, internal leads, sales teams, and cross-selling initiatives. Lead large, complex, and strategic sales opportunities, managing the full sales cycle from prospecting to contract negotiation and closing. Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline, ensuring accurate CRM management, forecasting, and reporting to senior leadership. Establish trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders across clinical operations, data management, biometrics, and procurement. Collaborate with account management teams to strengthen existing partnerships, drive account expansion, and support long-term client retention. Lead client presentations, proposals, commercial discussions, and contract negotiations. Work closely with product, proposals, delivery, operations, finance, and legal teams to align solutions with customer needs and ensure commercially viable agreements. Contribute to pricing strategies, deal structures, strategic partnerships, and service innovation. Monitor market developments, competitor activities, industry trends, and regulatory changes to identify opportunities and inform go-to-market strategies. Represent the elluminate business internally and externally, reinforcing its position as a trusted technology partner within the life sciences industry. Requirements: Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience preferred. At least 4 years of relevant combined experience in SaaS technology sales, data management, or business development within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, or broader life sciences sectors. Demonstrated success in selling SaaS solutions and technology platforms to life sciences organizations. Proven track record of closing large, complex, multi-year commercial agreements. Strong understanding of the clinical trial lifecycle, clinical data management, and the regulatory environment. Established professional network within pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations, particularly in biometrics and related functions, is highly desirable. Previous experience developing and managing strategic partnerships is an advantage. Excellent executive-level communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and the ability to translate complex customer challenges into valuable business solutions. Results-oriented, self-motivated, and comfortable adopting a consultative, value-based sales approach. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Highly collaborative, detail-oriented, and capable of working effectively within a cross-functional, international, and matrixed environment. Ability to use approved AI tools responsibly to improve productivity and work quality while protecting confidential information, validating generated content, and maintaining professional accountability. Benefits: Opportunity to join a fast-growing organization operating at the intersection of technology, clinical research, and healthcare. Remote working opportunity within Europe. International and collaborative working environment with opportunities to engage with global life sciences organizations. Career development and professional growth within an expanding technology business. Opportunity to contribute to innovative SaaS solutions that help accelerate clinical development and improve data-driven decision-making. Inclusive, people-first culture that values diversity, individual contributions, continuous learning, and professional development. Opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals across commercial, technology, product, and life sciences teams. Take ownership of technical support cases, ensuring timely investigation, effective troubleshooting, and satisfactory resolution of customer issues. Diagnose and resolve networking, endpoint security, and system-related problems ranging from straightforward incidents to complex technical challenges. Support customers with the deployment, integration, configuration, and maintenance of industrial cybersecurity products and solutions. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical issues, identify root causes, and deliver effective resolutions. Familiarity with Operational Technology (OT) environments, industrial control systems (ICS), and industrial processes is a strong advantage. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and manage customer expectations effectively. Well-organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision. jobs.title: Senior System Administrator (IST Time Zone)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Monitor system health, availability, and performance, proactively identifying and resolving operational issues to maintain reliable infrastructure. Perform system administration activities, including software updates, security patching, configuration management, and user access administration. Troubleshoot Linux and Windows environments, investigate incidents, and implement effective solutions to minimize operational disruptions. Develop, maintain, and improve technical documentation, including operational runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and troubleshooting guidelines. Identify opportunities to streamline infrastructure operations through automation and contribute to developing scripts, tools, and repeatable processes. Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to improve infrastructure visibility and incident response. Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to implement best practices, improve system reliability, and support continuous infrastructure optimization. Contribute to the development of scalable operational processes and support the evolution of infrastructure and DevOps practices. Requirements: At least 4 years of professional experience in IT operations, system administration, infrastructure engineering, or a related technical field. Solid foundational knowledge of Linux and/or Windows system administration, including system configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting. Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including IP addressing, DNS, connectivity, and basic network troubleshooting. Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent solutions. Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, with an understanding of cloud infrastructure fundamentals. Familiarity with scripting or programming languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash, and an interest in developing automation capabilities. Understanding of automation practices and an interest in DevOps methodologies and infrastructure optimization. Familiarity with version control systems such as Git is an advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with excellent attention to detail. Ability to document technical processes and solutions clearly and effectively. Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively within distributed, international teams. Proactive mindset, willingness to learn, and enthusiasm for solving technical challenges and improving operational efficiency. Ability to work in alignment with the IST time zone. Benefits: Flexible working arrangements, including remote, office-based, or hybrid options. Competitive salary and comprehensive compensation package. Personalized career development and growth opportunities. Professional development resources, including mentorship programs, technical talks, training sessions, and centers of excellence. Access to active technical communities and regular knowledge-sharing initiatives. Education and professional development reimbursement. Memorable anniversary gifts and recognition initiatives. Corporate events, team-building activities, and opportunities to connect with colleagues. Additional location-specific benefits. Please note that certain benefits may not apply to freelancers.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Postgres Tooling
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Co-maintain and progressively take technical ownership of an open-source PostgreSQL schema comparison and migration engine, reviewing contributions and eventually growing into its lead maintainer. Review, evaluate, and merge code contributions, including AI-generated pull requests, while ensuring high standards of correctness, maintainability, and security. Investigate and resolve reported issues related to schema differences, dependency ordering, migration generation, and PostgreSQL compatibility. Expand automated testing and validation coverage across multiple PostgreSQL versions to ensure consistent and reliable behavior. Ensure generated database migrations are safe, privilege-aware, and designed to prevent unintended data loss or security regressions. Identify potentially destructive schema changes and implement mechanisms to detect them and generate safer alternatives wherever possible. Contribute to the development of a stable 1.0 release, including defining public APIs, establishing semantic versioning contracts, improving documentation, and expanding PostgreSQL extension support. Engage with the open-source community by managing issue reports, reviewing external contributions, providing technical guidance, and maintaining constructive discussions with contributors. Collaborate with internal engineering teams to ensure consistent migration generation and execution across products, platform services, database branching, and AI-powered workflows. Write technical design documents, define architectural direction, and establish engineering strategies for the continued evolution of the tooling. Participate in the engineering team's on-call rotation, helping investigate and resolve production-related issues while supporting reliable software delivery. Requirements: At least 8 years of professional software engineering experience, including extensive hands-on experience with PostgreSQL. Deep understanding of PostgreSQL internals, particularly system catalogs such as pg_catalog and pg_depend , object ownership, permissions, grants, default privileges, Row-Level Security (RLS) policies, and extension membership. Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL DDL operations and database migration semantics, including locking behavior, transactional limitations, dependency management, and the identification of potentially destructive changes. A security-conscious engineering mindset, with particular attention to preventing unauthorized privilege changes, accidental access exposure, and unintended data loss. Strong proficiency in TypeScript and the ability to develop reliable, maintainable, and well-tested software. Experience designing advanced testing strategies for correctness, including differential testing, property-based testing, and test corpus validation across multiple PostgreSQL versions. Familiarity with compiler-style engineering challenges, including dependency graphs, topological sorting, cycle detection, and schema comparison algorithms. Ability to review and understand complex code changes within sophisticated codebases, including contributions generated with AI-assisted development tools. Proven experience owning and maintaining production software, including staged releases, error monitoring, incident investigation, and responding to real-world user feedback. Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across multiple teams, from initial problem definition and architectural planning through production implementation. Excellent written communication skills and the ability to document technical decisions clearly. Ability to work independently, manage priorities effectively, and collaborate successfully within asynchronous, globally distributed engineering teams. Nice to Have: Previous experience developing or maintaining database schema comparison and migration tools such as migra, pg-schema-diff, Atlas, pgroll, sqitch, Prisma Migrate, Flyway, or Liquibase. Familiarity with PostgreSQL backup and sc

jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Digital Marketing Specialist based in India. We are looking for a creative, analytical, and results-driven Digital Marketing Specialist to plan, execute, and optimize digital marketing campaigns for growing U.S.-based businesses. In this role, you will take ownership of online marketing initiatives across multiple channels, helping strengthen brand visibility, attract audiences, and drive measurable business results. You will combine creativity with data analysis to identify opportunities, improve campaign performance, and maximize marketing effectiveness. Working closely with design, sales, and leadership teams, you will contribute to developing engaging content and impactful marketing strategies. You will also monitor industry trends, explore new tools, and continuously test innovative approaches. This fully remote opportunity offers a collaborative environment where your ideas and insights can directly influence brand growth and marketing success. Create, review, and optimize advertising copy, promotional messages, and other digital marketing content to engage target audiences. Collaborate with designers and cross-functional team members to develop creative concepts, marketing assets, and campaign materials. Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and market trend monitoring to identify new opportunities and improve marketing strategies. jobs.title: Senior Accounts Receivable Specialist
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Accounts Receivable Specialist based in India. We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Accounts Receivable Specialist to manage and optimize the billing, invoicing, and collections processes for growing U.S.-based businesses. In this role, you will take ownership of the accounts receivable cycle, ensuring accurate financial records, timely payments, and effective cash flow management. You will work closely with accounting, sales, customers, and leadership teams to resolve discrepancies and improve collection performance. Your analytical skills and proactive approach will help identify payment delays, strengthen financial processes, and maintain reliable reporting. This fully remote opportunity offers exposure to international business operations and direct collaboration with decision-makers. It is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional who values accuracy, accountability, and continuous process improvement. Accountabilities:: Prepare, review, and issue accurate customer invoices and quotations, ensuring compliance with contractual agreements and purchase orders. Verify invoice details against customer orders, contracts, and supporting documentation, identifying and correcting discrepancies when necessary. Monitor outstanding accounts receivable balances and proactively follow up with customers to secure overdue payments. Manage collections activities professionally and consistently, maintaining positive customer relationships while ensuring timely payment. Respond to customer inquiries regarding invoices, payment terms, billing discrepancies, and account balances with clarity and professionalism. Record and reconcile incoming payments against outstanding invoices, investigating and resolving payment discrepancies. Identify the root causes of delayed payments and develop practical solutions to improve collection efficiency and reduce outstanding balances. Prepare regular accounts receivable, collections, and revenue reports to provide leadership with accurate financial insights. Maintain data consistency across accounting platforms and other business systems, ensuring accurate and up-to-date financial records. Identify opportunities to improve billing and collections workflows through better tools, automation, and standardized procedures. Collaborate with accounting, sales, and management teams to strengthen financial coordination and optimize the overall payment cycle. Requirements: At least 5 years of professional experience in accounts receivable, billing, collections, or a related accounting and finance position. Practical experience using QuickBooks or comparable accounting and financial management software. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, with the ability to manage financial data, reconciliations, and reporting. Solid understanding of accounts receivable processes, invoicing, payment allocation, collections, and account reconciliation. Excellent attention to detail, with the ability to identify inconsistencies, investigate discrepancies, and maintain accurate financial records. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly when investigating delayed payments and resolving complex billing issues. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain financial and billing matters clearly to customers and non-finance stakeholders. Strong interpersonal skills and a customer-oriented approach, with the ability to manage payment follow-ups professionally, confidently, and diplomatically. Ability to work independently, take ownership of responsibilities, identify potential issues, and communicate challenges proactively. Experience working with multiple accounting platforms or payment systems is considered an advantage. Availability to work in alignment with U.S. Eastern business hours. A suitable

Requirements: Professional experience: At least 4 years of experience in manual quality assurance or software testing, primarily involving web applications or backend systems. Testing fundamentals: Strong understanding of software testing principles, test design techniques, and quality assurance methodologies. English proficiency: Upper-Intermediate level of English or higher. Java testing frameworks: Familiarity with JUnit, TestNG, Selenium, Selenide, or REST Assured. jobs.title: English to Belarusian Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Own linguistic quality standards for the Belarusian locale, ensuring consistent interpretation and application of client requirements across all relevant content types. Review style guide and glossary updates, assess their impact on quality categories and content types, and document changes and evolving expectations. Monitor client feedback, corrections, and decisions from calibration and quality meetings to identify implicit expectations and maintain alignment with the client’s Language Manager. Serve as the primary linguistic contact for quality discussions, clarifications, arbitration, and escalations, ensuring concerns are supported by clear evidence. Organize regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish monthly quality reports covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, recurring errors, and arbitration outcomes. Coach reviewers individually using specific examples and conduct shadowing sessions based on real alignment data. Analyze error patterns, severity trends, and alignment scores to identify opportunities for quality improvement. Convert recurring justification patterns into well-supported style guide proposals and share relevant cross-locale insights with quality management. Maintain ownership of the locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance, the community’s shared understanding of quality, and the integrity of arbitration records. Build and maintain an effective working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, tracking expectations and helping reduce quality discrepancies over time. Requirements: 3–5+ years of experience in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), senior language lead positions, or quality governance roles. Proven experience managing client and stakeholder relationships, ideally as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers. Hands-on experience managing formal arbitration and escalation processes, facilitating discussions, and resolving linguistic disagreements. Strong practical knowledge of localization quality evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping. Ability to analyze style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and understand differing quality requirements across content types such as marketing, legal, and UI. Experience facilitating one-to-one coaching, reviewer shadowing, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting. Strong analytical skills, including the ability to track error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and translate findings into actionable improvements. Native-level Belarusian proficiency and professional-level English. Excellent communication, organization, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Preferred: Previous experience supporting large-scale technology localization programs and familiarity with calibration or alignment tools. Benefits: Freelance / independent contractor engagement with an expected workload of approximately 24 hours per month. Opportunity to build a long-term partnership with global teams working on high-visibility technology products. Steady project volume and ongoing collaboration. jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities: As Accounting Manager, you will oversee the complete accounting function, ensuring financial accuracy, operational efficiency, and compliance with relevant accounting standards. You will work closely with leadership and accounting support teams to maintain reliable financial records and improve financial processes. Manage the full accounting cycle, including account reconciliations, month-end closing, and year-end closing. Prepare and deliver accurate monthly financial statements, including profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements. Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, expense management, and vendor payments. Identify billing discrepancies, unusual transactions, and potential financial errors to protect business resources. Integrate external tools and applications with accounting systems such as QuickBooks Online to streamline workflows. Prepare accurate and organized financial records for annual reviews and external CPA firms. Support leadership with budgeting, financial forecasting, and cash flow planning. Develop and strengthen internal controls, accounting policies, and procedures as the business grows. Supervise and support bookkeepers or accounting staff, providing guidance and constructive feedback. Use digital collaboration and accounting tools, including QuickBooks Online, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Bill.com, Gusto, Ramp, and ClickUp. Requirements: The ideal candidate is an experienced accounting professional with a strong understanding of U.S. accounting practices, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to independently manage financial operations. You should be comfortable working in a remote environment, communicating financial information clearly, and taking ownership of accounting processes. At least 5 years of accounting experience working with U.S.-based companies, including full-cycle accounting responsibilities. Strong knowledge of U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP). Advanced experience with QuickBooks Online or a comparable accounting platform, including integrating third-party applications. CPA certification or a local accounting qualification, such as Contador Público, is an advantage. Previous experience collaborating with external CPA firms or supporting multiple clients is a plus. Experience supervising, mentoring, or guiding accounting professionals, even without a formal management title. Strong financial judgment and the ability to navigate fast-paced business environments. Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain financial concepts to non-financial stakeholders. Excellent written communication skills and the ability to provide clear updates to remote teams. High levels of ownership, integrity, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. Must be based in Latin America (LATAM) or Europe. Benefits: Competitive salary in USD, paid consistently on a monthly basis and determined by experience. 10 paid vacation days per year. jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will own the design and implementation of key website experiences, balancing creative excellence with technical quality and business objectives. Your responsibilities will include: Lead the design and development of core website experiences, including the homepage, product pages, pricing pages, and navigation, from initial exploration through responsive implementation and launch. Translate complex technical product concepts into clear visual explanations, engaging interfaces, and interactive demonstrations that help users understand and evaluate the platform. Refine typography, visual hierarchy, composition, motion, and interaction details to create a distinctive and consistent experience across devices. Build and maintain reusable components, design tokens, and page patterns that connect the visual design system with production code. Develop accessible, mobile-friendly, high-performance website experiences that follow modern web standards and work consistently across browsers. Collaborate with Design, Marketing, Growth, and engineering partners on product launches, website experiments, and conversion-focused initiatives. Take projects through design reviews, testing, release, and ongoing optimization, using user feedback and website performance data to improve usability and conversion. Share ideas proactively, develop prototypes, and make thoughtful decisions that balance creative ambition, technical feasibility, and delivery timelines. Explore and implement AI-powered workflows, including machine-readable design specifications, reusable skills, and internal tools that accelerate creative and development processes. Help evolve the website's design system and identify opportunities to improve collaboration, consistency, and production efficiency. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines exceptional visual design judgment with strong frontend engineering capabilities and a proven ability to deliver polished digital experiences independently. You should be comfortable moving between design tools and code, experimenting with new technologies, and collaborating with distributed teams. Key qualifications include: 6–10 years of relevant experience designing and building websites or interactive digital experiences. A track record of owning projects end to end as a hands-on individual contributor. An active portfolio website, GitHub profile, or relevant social profile showcasing high-quality websites and interactive experiences, with a clear indication of your personal contributions. Strong visual and interaction design fundamentals, including typography, hierarchy, spacing, composition, and responsive layouts. Advanced proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript. Experience building production websites with React and modern web frameworks such as Astro. Hands-on experience with canvas animations and shaders, and the ability to prototype motion and interactions directly in the browser. Proficiency in Figma and experience exploring design concepts through both visual tools and code. Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools and the ability to use AI-first workflows to accelerate design exploration and implementation. Practical knowledge of web performance, accessibility standards, and browser behavior, including the ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues. Ability to translate open-ended briefs into finished digital experiences, explain design and technical decisions, and incorporate feedback from different disciplines. Strong initiative, independent problem-solving skills, and clear communication in a fully distributed team. Proficiency with macOS and comfort collaborating remotely using tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, and Zoom. Additional experience that would be advantageous: Experience with three.js, WebGL, motion.dev, Blender, or other 3D and animation technologies. Background working on technical B2B products. Experience with Astro and interactive data visualization. Benefits: Ann

jobs.title: Creative Program Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will own the planning and execution of major creative programs, ensuring that deliverables meet strategic objectives, retailer specifications, production requirements, and launch deadlines. Your responsibilities will include: Lead end-to-end planning and artwork delivery for high-priority Shopper creative programs, including in-store displays, shelf signage, toppers, clings, point-of-sale materials, and retailer-specific collateral. Manage multiple concurrent workstreams and establish project-specific timelines covering briefs, concept development, design iterations, stakeholder reviews, packaging renders, proofing, production lead times, and final delivery. Partner with Shopper project managers and teams across Brand, Innovation, Commercialization, and Production to define project scope, deliverables, requirements, and priorities. Coordinate creative milestones with broader Shopper programs, retail media initiatives, promotional campaigns, and product launch schedules. Maintain accurate project plans in Asana, ensuring clear ownership, dependencies, decisions, and progress visibility. Identify risks and potential blockers early, make informed trade-off decisions, and escalate high-impact issues to leadership with clear recommendations. Lead creative workflow coordination and artwork handoffs across Shopper initiatives, packaging, trade show assets, and sales materials. Organize project kickoffs, working sessions, stakeholder reviews, and approval processes, ensuring feedback is consolidated and decisions are reached efficiently. Coordinate with Creative leads and production partners on design requirements, print specifications, file formats, production feasibility, and delivery timelines. Manage packaging render development, print proofing, pilot participation, and production-readiness reviews. Ensure retailer-specific creative guidelines, asset requirements, and approval processes are reflected in project plans. Identify recurring workflow challenges and implement scalable improvements that increase efficiency and consistency across the Creative function. Mentor colleagues on project planning, stakeholder communication, accountability, and creative program management best practices. Stay informed about retail, Shopper marketing, and consumer packaged goods (CPG) trends, sharing relevant insights and solutions with the wider team. Requirements: The ideal candidate brings extensive experience managing complex creative programs, strong knowledge of retail and Shopper execution, and the ability to operate autonomously while influencing stakeholders across multiple functions. You should understand how creative development and production requirements interact, and be comfortable making decisions in a dynamic environment. Key qualifications include: 8+ years of project or program management experience, ideally within the consumer packaged goods (CPG) industry, an in-house creative team, or an agency environment. Demonstrated experience leading large, high-priority creative programs with multiple stakeholders and concurrent workstreams. Strong knowledge of Shopper creative formats and retail environments, including in-store displays, point-of-sale materials, shelf signage, and retailer-specific collateral. Deep understanding of the creative development process, from briefing and concept exploration through design iterations, reviews, approvals, production readiness, and final artwork delivery. Experience coordinating creative deliverables for major retailers and adapting workflows to different specifications, guidelines, and approval requirements. jobs.title: Growth Marketing Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Develop and execute multi-channel lead-generation strategies that attract qualified prospects, improve conversion rates, and support business growth. Own and optimize the complete lead-generation funnel, from traffic acquisition and lead capture through Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs), Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs), and sales opportunities. Maintain accountability for lead quality, pipeline contribution, and the overall effectiveness of marketing initiatives. Manage marketing projects end to end, including market research, strategic planning, campaign development, execution, testing, performance analysis, and continuous optimization. Plan and implement organic-first, multi-channel growth programs, coordinating SEO, PPC, content, design, and development specialists to achieve campaign objectives. Identify new growth opportunities through market research, competitor analysis, audience insights, and marketing performance data. Monitor and report on the entire lead-generation funnel, analyzing traffic acquisition, landing-page engagement, lead capture, nurturing, qualification, and conversion. Plan and execute conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives to improve user experience, increase conversions, and strengthen lead-generation performance. Continuously optimize website performance, organic search visibility, user experience, and conversion rates, implementing improvements independently or in collaboration with specialists. Support outbound marketing and account-based marketing (ABM) initiatives in partnership with Sales and Business Development teams. Work closely with Sales to understand lead quality, customer needs, and market feedback, using these insights to refine audience targeting, messaging, and campaign effectiveness. Requirements: At least 5 years of experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, or demand generation, with a demonstrated track record of generating qualified leads and improving marketing performance. Experience in B2B software development, IT services, SaaS, or the technology sector, preferably involving complex buying journeys and longer sales cycles. At least 2 years of experience owning marketing campaigns or cross-functional initiatives from strategic planning through execution and performance evaluation. Strong understanding of multi-channel marketing, including content, email, social media, PPC, and CRO. Working knowledge of SEO and GEO/AEO, including keyword research, search intent, and strategies for improving organic visibility. Strong analytical capabilities and hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio, or comparable analytics and reporting tools. Ability to connect marketing activities and performance metrics to qualified leads, sales pipeline, and revenue outcomes. Strong proficiency with AI tools and practical experience using them to improve research, content creation, data analysis, and campaign workflows. Solid understanding of audience segmentation, targeting, positioning, and messaging, with the ability to develop compelling value propositions for different customer groups. Proactive, ownership-driven mindset, with a willingness to experiment, prioritize initiatives based on potential impact, and move projects forward independently. Excellent communication and organizational skills, including the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams, guide specialists, and provide constructive feedback. Fluent English proficiency at C1 level or higher. Nice-to-have qualifications: Experience with marketing automation tools, CRM platforms, email nurturing sequences, and lead qualification processes. Advanced knowledge of conversion rate optimization, landing-page experimentation, and user behavior analysis. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement, with the freedom to work from anywhere with a stable internet connection. Flexible working hours and the ability to choose a preferred time zone and work schedule. Competitive, negotiable hourly

jobs.title: Showrunner - Storyby
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Take full creative ownership of individual film projects, ensuring quality and consistency throughout the entire production lifecycle. Develop concepts and stories for vertical series, from initial ideas and synopses to episode outlines and finalized scripts. Build compelling season narratives, including character and romantic arcs, conflicts, emotional turning points, engaging hooks, and cliffhangers. Review, edit, and provide constructive feedback on scripts, ensuring they meet creative and storytelling expectations. Oversee editing and post-production, reviewing cuts and providing direction on pacing, narrative structure, music, sound, emotional impact, and overall storytelling. Conduct final creative quality checks to ensure each finished film aligns with its original vision and content standards. Collaborate closely with screenwriters, producers, editors, and other creative professionals throughout production. Research vertical dramas, short-form entertainment, and emerging market trends, translating insights into innovative content strategies. Analyze audience feedback and post-release performance metrics to identify opportunities and apply learnings to future productions. Leverage AI-powered tools to support content development, creative iteration, and production workflows. Requirements: Hands-on experience writing or developing scripts for films, television series, digital entertainment, or short-form content. Strong understanding of dramatic storytelling and serialized narratives, including character development, pacing, conflict, hooks, and cliffhangers. Knowledge of editing and post-production processes, with an understanding of how scene structure, music, sound, and editing choices influence audience engagement. Ability to oversee a production holistically, from initial script development to final editing, making creative decisions that strengthen the finished story. Strong sense of ownership and accountability for the overall creative outcome of each production. Understanding of mobile-first audiences and the specific storytelling techniques that distinguish vertical series from traditional films and television. Ability to manage multiple creative iterations efficiently and give and receive constructive feedback. Excellent creative judgment, independent decision-making, and problem-solving skills. English proficiency at B2 level or above. Nice to have: Experience working on vertical dramas or microdramas. Previous collaboration with video editors and post-production teams. Experience in performance marketing or working closely with performance teams, with an understanding of how creative concepts, hooks, and storytelling influence audience attention and conversion. Familiarity with content formats and trends on platforms such as ReelShort, DramaBox, and ShortMax. Experience using AI tools for text, image, or video generation. jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst based in India. As a Senior Financial Analyst, you will play a key role in transforming financial data into actionable insights that support strategic business decisions. You will work closely with accounting, operations, and leadership teams at growing U.S.-based businesses, providing accurate reporting, financial forecasts, and performance analysis. Your responsibilities will span financial modeling, budgeting, KPI tracking, and process improvement. You will help identify financial trends, uncover discrepancies, monitor costs, and improve reporting accuracy. This is an opportunity to have a direct impact on business performance while working in a fully remote, collaborative environment. The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable communicating complex financial information clearly to stakeholders. Accountabilities:: Develop and maintain financial models and forecasts to support strategic planning and informed business decisions. Prepare accurate monthly and quarterly financial reports, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements. Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and develop dashboards that provide clear visibility into business performance. Support budgeting processes, expense planning, and financial projections. Analyze actual financial results against budgets and forecasts, investigate significant variances, identify underlying causes, and communicate actionable recommendations. Reconcile financial data across accounting systems and other business tools, identifying inconsistencies and resolving errors proactively. Monitor cost increases, declining profit margins, and unusual financial transactions to identify potential risks and improvement opportunities. Establish and maintain data standards and reporting practices to ensure financial records remain accurate and consistent as the business grows. Prepare ad hoc financial analyses and reports to address leadership requests and support operational decisions. Identify opportunities to improve financial reporting tools, workflows, and processes to increase efficiency, accuracy, and reliability. Requirements: At least 5 years of professional experience in financial analysis, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), accounting, or business operations. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including pivot tables, lookup functions, and structured financial modeling. Practical knowledge of QuickBooks or comparable accounting software. Experience using financial dashboards, reporting platforms, and data visualization tools. Strong analytical abilities and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to identify meaningful discrepancies and financial trends. Ability to interpret complex financial information and communicate findings clearly to stakeholders without a finance background. Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the confidence to raise concerns and recommend improvements. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with accounting, operations, and leadership teams. Availability to work in alignment with U.S. Eastern Time business hours. Must be based in India. Nice to have: SQL knowledge or experience working with financial data through database queries. Benefits: Competitive compensation: Salary paid in USD on a consistent monthly basis, with the amount determined by experience and qualifications. Fully remote work: 100% remote working arrangement with the flexibility to work from a professional home setup. Paid time off: 10 paid vacation days per year. Public holidays: All U.S. national holidays observed. Direct leadership exposure: Work closely with business leaders and contribute directly to financial reporting and strategic decision-making. jobs.title: Assurance Climate Risk Consultant
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Develop and refine climate risk indicators and comprehensive frameworks covering both physical and transition risks. Design indicators using the IPCC AR6 hazard, exposure, and vulnerability framework, including thresholds, normalization methods, scoring and classification logic, and aggregation from grid cells to assets, basins, and portfolios. Support the development of climate scenario analysis solutions aligned with IFRS S2 and ESRS methodologies, including selecting, processing, and validating climate projection datasets across emissions scenarios, time horizons, and baseline periods. Prepare detailed indicator specifications, data dictionaries, and methodology documentation that Product and Engineering teams can implement and that provide sufficient auditability for client disclosures. Assess the financial implications of climate scenarios, including cost modeling and financial impact assessments across sectors such as manufacturing, technology, and textiles. Contribute to the development of climate resilience and adaptation opportunity libraries linked to identified potential risks. Validate climate indicators against observed data and published benchmarks, conduct sensitivity analyses, and establish methods for communicating uncertainty and confidence to platform users. Support climate-related disclosure preparation in accordance with CSRD/ESRS and IFRS S2, including identifying and mapping relevant data points, metrics, and reporting requirements. Lead and support CSRD limited-assurance readiness activities by establishing evidence trails, controls, and documentation capable of withstanding external assurance reviews. Monitor and interpret evolving CSRD/ESRS and IFRS regulatory guidance, identifying changes that may affect ongoing projects and internal methodologies. Collaborate with the Professional Services team to translate technical climate and disclosure requirements into practical internal frameworks, methodologies, and deliverables. Contribute to CSRD requirements gap analyses and define the work needed for preliminary disclosures, dry runs, and first-time reporting exercises. Ensure consistency and alignment between climate risk methodologies and existing water risk indicators. Deliver internal training and knowledge-sharing sessions to strengthen the broader team's understanding of climate risk and disclosure requirements. Requirements: Mandatory assurance experience: Hands-on experience in sustainability or climate assurance at a Big Four firm, ideally within a Climate Change and Sustainability Services practice, including CSRD/ESRS or climate-related assurance engagements. Candidates must understand the evidence, controls, and documentation required to successfully support a limited-assurance review. This is a non-negotiable requirement. Bachelor's degree in Climate Science, Environmental Science, Sustainability, or a related discipline. A Master's degree or PhD in Climate Science, Atmospheric Science, Hydrology, Geosciences, or a related field is also expected. At least 7 years of senior-level experience in climate risk and resilience assessment, corporate sustainability, climate disclosure consulting, or sustainability assurance. Demonstrated experience leading or owning climate risk, sustainability reporting, or CSRD-related engagements from beginning to end. Strong working knowledge of climate-related financial disclosure frameworks, particularly IFRS S2, together with familiarity with CSRD and ESRS requirements. Experience working with physical and transition climate risk scenarios and datasets, including NGFS scenarios, IEA pathways, carbon price trajectories, and sector decarbonization pathways such as SBTi and TPI. Understanding of how climate scenarios translate into financial impacts, including the ability to assess potential costs and business exposure. Experience integrating climate risk considerations into enterprise risk management systems and corporate disclosure frameworks.

jobs.title: English to Belarusian Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content

Strong practical knowledge of localization quality evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping. jobs.title: Travel Advisor
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Plan, coordinate, and book personalized travel arrangements, including flights, accommodation, vacation packages, and other travel-related services. Develop customized travel itineraries based on clients' preferences, interests, budgets, schedules, and desired experiences. Research destinations, travel options, accommodation providers, and activities to provide relevant recommendations and help clients make informed decisions. Manage client inquiries and communications professionally, providing timely assistance, answering questions, and supporting travelers throughout the booking process. Handle reservations, maintain accurate client records, and ensure appropriate follow-ups to deliver a smooth and organized customer experience. Monitor travel industry trends, seasonal promotions, destination updates, and available offers to provide clients with competitive and relevant travel options. Build positive client relationships through personalized recommendations, attentive service, and consistent communication. Use the provided business tools and personal website to manage travel-related activities and develop your professional presence. Continuously develop your knowledge of destinations, travel products, booking processes, and industry opportunities to improve service quality and client satisfaction. Requirements: Must be at least 18 years old. Must reside in an eligible country where the partner is authorized to operate. Please note that India is not included in the eligible countries listed in the original job posting, so applicants based in India should confirm their eligibility with the hiring partner before proceeding. No previous travel industry experience is required; motivated beginners and individuals looking to transition into the travel sector are encouraged to apply. Genuine passion for travel, tourism, discovering new destinations, and helping others create memorable travel experiences. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally and effectively with clients. Customer-focused mindset and a genuine commitment to delivering personalized service and positive client experiences. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly when managing reservations, travel itineraries, and client information. Ability to understand client needs, recommend suitable travel options, and customize experiences within established budgets. Basic budgeting and financial management skills, with the ability to compare travel options and identify solutions that align with client expectations. Self-motivation, adaptability, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. Willingness to learn new booking tools, industry platforms, and travel-related systems while staying informed about market developments. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement, allowing you to work from home. Flexible schedule, providing greater autonomy over your working hours. Access to travel discounts and exclusive industry incentives. Dedicated personal website to support your travel advisory activities and professional presence. Business tools and resources provided to help manage your travel-related activities. Liability insurance included. Access to familiarization (FAM) travel opportunities to discover destinations and gain firsthand industry knowledge. Professional certifications and learning opportunities to support your development in the travel industry. Opportunity to build a career in travel planning without requiring previous professional experience. Potential to develop valuable customer service, travel consulting, and business management skills.

jobs.title: Middle QA Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Take ownership of establishing, implementing, and maintaining a reliable regression testing strategy for an existing enterprise application. Collaborate with the client's team to analyze, reverse-engineer, and document critical business workflows and user scenarios. Explore the existing application to identify essential functionality, edge cases, undocumented business rules, and potential areas of risk. Design and document regression, characterization (golden master), and exploratory test scenarios before major system changes and modernization activities. Perform manual API and HTTP testing to validate application behavior and ensure critical functionality remains intact. Introduce basic automated checks for selected business workflows and APIs, working alongside engineers and using AI-assisted tools where appropriate. Support the integration of automated tests into Azure DevOps pipelines. Execute functional, regression, smoke, and security-related testing during development and release cycles. Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities and collaborate with stakeholders to validate business requirements. Investigate test failures, application logs, and stack traces to identify potential defects and communicate findings effectively. Work closely with developers and the Product Owner to clarify requirements, investigate unexpected application behavior, and resolve quality-related issues. Maintain clear, structured, and up-to-date QA documentation to support testing activities and future system changes. Requirements: 3–5 years of professional experience in Manual QA or Software Testing, primarily focused on web applications or backend systems. Strong understanding of software testing fundamentals, methodologies, and test design techniques. Practical experience designing, executing, and maintaining regression test suites, smoke tests, sanity checks, and release validation criteria. Ability to independently analyze business workflows, identify potential risks, and translate functional requirements into comprehensive test cases and scenarios. Hands-on experience with exploratory testing and API testing. Good understanding of HTTP fundamentals, cookies, sessions, and typical web application architecture. Practical experience using API testing tools such as Postman, Insomnia, or curl. Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and Azure DevOps (ADO), including executing existing pipeline jobs, reviewing results, and investigating failures. Basic familiarity with application logs, stack traces, and build tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a structured approach to identifying and investigating defects. Good communication and documentation skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Upper-Intermediate or higher English proficiency. Nice to Have: Basic experience with test automation or a strong willingness to learn and introduce simple automated checks using AI-assisted tools. Familiarity with Java-based testing tools and frameworks, including JUnit, TestNG, Selenium, Selenide, or REST Assured. Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot to generate basic test scripts or test skeletons, with the ability to review, validate, and refine generated code. Previous experience testing applications during framework upgrades, platform modernization, or backend migrations. Familiarity with characterization testing, golden master testing, or other techniques for comparing application behavior before and after system changes. Experience working with legacy Java applications, Apache Tomcat, or servlet-based systems. Familiarity with XML, XSLT, or server-side rendering technologies. Basic understanding of application security principles and common OWASP vulnerabilities. Benefits: Flexible Working Arrangements: Choose between remote work, office-based work, or a flexible hybrid setup. Competitive Compensa

jobs.title: Growth Product Manager | Uplift
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Own and optimize the complete user conversion funnel, from landing pages and onboarding to free trials, first payments, recurring subscriptions, and additional purchases. Analyze user behavior at every stage of the journey to identify conversion bottlenecks and opportunities for growth. Develop, prioritize, and validate growth hypotheses through A/B testing of paywalls, pricing strategies, trial mechanics, onboarding experiences, and upselling scenarios. Manage the full experimentation cycle, including hypothesis development, test design, implementation, performance analysis, and decision-making. Monitor and optimize key business metrics, including Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Lifetime Value (LTV), trial-to-paid conversion, recurring payments, refunds, chargebacks, and customer acquisition payback periods. Collaborate with user acquisition and marketing teams to identify scalable acquisition channels, analyze traffic quality, and evaluate cohort performance across different sources. Research new geographical markets and product niches, validate opportunities through cost-efficient experiments, and scale successful initiatives. Drive product features from initial concept to production by preparing clear specifications, coordinating with development and design teams, reviewing deliverables, and measuring their impact. Improve subscriber retention and monetization by identifying the features, experiences, and value propositions that encourage users to stay longer and make additional purchases. Continuously use product and marketing data to guide strategic decisions and improve overall business performance. Requirements: At least 3 years of professional experience in Growth or Product Management within B2C businesses. Mandatory experience working with subscription-based web products and a strong understanding of subscription business models. Proven track record of building and optimizing conversion funnels, supported by measurable results and clear before-and-after performance metrics. Hands-on experience managing the complete A/B testing process, with a solid understanding of statistical significance and experimentation methodology. Strong knowledge of unit economics and the relationships between CAC, LTV, conversion rates, recurring payments, and overall profitability. Good understanding of performance marketing channels, particularly Google, Meta, and Snap, with the ability to collaborate effectively with media buyers. Technical awareness and understanding of APIs, frontend and backend development, and common technical constraints, enabling informed product decisions and trade-offs. Ability to independently retrieve, analyze, and interpret data using SQL, Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4, Looker, or similar analytics tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a data-driven approach to decision-making. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and translate business objectives into actionable product initiatives. High degree of autonomy, ownership, and accountability, with the ability to drive projects from idea to execution without close supervision. Benefits: Product Ownership: Opportunity to build a digital product from the ground up and actively influence strategic and operational decisions. Autonomy and Impact: A results-oriented environment that encourages initiative, independent decision-making, and ownership of meaningful projects. Talented Team: Work alongside experienced professionals who share their knowledge, support one another, and contribute to continuous improvement. Learning and Development: Access to internal and external expert sessions, professional courses, and ongoing learning opportunities. Flexible Work Arrangements: Fully remote work options, with additional access to an office in Kyiv and coworking spaces in Lviv and Warsaw. Flexible Schedule: Freedom to organize your working hours according to your pref

jobs.title: 3D Artist
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Create high-quality 3D vehicle models for a mobile racing game. Model automotive tuning and customization components, including body kits, bumpers, spoilers, hoods, wheels, and other vehicle parts. Produce both Low Poly and High Poly models, including UV mapping and texture baking. Develop PBR materials and textures that align with the game's artistic direction and visual requirements. Optimize geometry, textures, materials, and assets to ensure smooth performance on mobile devices. Prepare and integrate 3D assets into Unity, including prefab creation and material and shader configuration. Incorporate AI-powered tools into the 3D production pipeline to generate visual references, prototype ideas, support modeling and texturing, and improve workflow efficiency. Collaborate closely with artists and game designers to maintain visual consistency and achieve the desired level of quality. Requirements: At least 4 years of professional experience in game development, preferably on mobile gaming projects. A portfolio showcasing vehicles or other types of machinery, with demonstrated experience in vehicle modeling and a solid understanding of automotive structures, proportions, and shapes. Strong polygonal modeling skills and experience creating both Low Poly and High Poly assets. Solid knowledge of PBR texturing workflows, including material creation, UV mapping, texture baking, and working with texture maps. Practical experience with Substance 3D Painter or comparable texturing software. Confident working knowledge of Unity, including prefab creation, material and shader configuration, and 3D asset integration. Understanding of mobile graphics optimization, including polygon budgets, texture and material optimization, draw calls, and rendering performance. Hands-on experience using AI tools within 3D production workflows, including reference generation, prototyping, model and texture creation assistance, and process optimization. Proficiency in Blender, Maya, 3ds Max, or equivalent 3D modeling software. Strong artistic fundamentals, including an understanding of form, proportions, volume, lighting, and materials. Ability to work effectively with visual references and consistently follow an established artistic direction. Benefits: Flexible Benefits Budget: Access to a personalized benefits allowance that can be used for insurance, professional education, gym memberships, or other services that support your well-being and personal balance. Performance Bonuses: Recognition and rewards for outstanding achievements, initiative, teamwork, and meaningful contributions. Remote-First Environment: Fully remote working arrangements within Europe. Business Impact: Opportunities to contribute to business decisions, improve internal processes, and bring your ideas to life. Professional Development: Access to learning opportunities, internal training sessions, and strategic workshops to strengthen your expertise and support career growth. Collaborative Culture: Join a supportive, team-oriented environment where shared achievements and collective success are valued. Hiring Process: The expected recruitment stages are: Initial interview with a recruiter. Practical test assignment. Interview with the hiring manager. Reference checks. Offer.
