jobs.region: Remote - Europe / South Korea / Dubai, UAE / Berlin, Germany / Remote / Remote, Worldwide
jobs.description: About Welo Global Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com The Role We are seeking an experienced English into Kazakh Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client. You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content. Project Details - Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below) - Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month - Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract - Task type: Language Lead Support - Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support - Language pair: English into Kazakh What You Will Do -Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down. -Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes. -Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions from real alignment data. -Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager. -Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time. What You Will Own -The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance -The community’s shared understanding of quality -The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced -The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking Requirements - Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles - Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution - Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping - Style guide and expectation analysis:

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Self-Serve
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Own and optimize the complete self-serve funnel, defining, measuring, and improving each stage, including signup, trial, activation, paid conversion, and customer expansion. Act as the product owner for the website and application interface, setting the roadmap, defining priorities, and driving improvements to the overall user experience. Collaborate closely with engineering leads, developers, and designers to deliver product and website enhancements that capture demand and increase funnel performance. Design and run conversion experiments, including A/B tests, while partnering with design and product marketing teams to refine messaging, content, formats, and user journeys. Improve product-led growth journeys originating in developer communities, open-source projects, and emerging AI agent ecosystems. Develop a deep understanding of developer workflows, including documentation, SDKs, code examples, and the initial hands-on product experience, to remove friction and encourage adoption. Build intelligent customer data and segmentation approaches using product usage signals and firmographic information to support personalized onboarding, relevant content, and customer nurturing. Work with Revenue Operations to identify product-qualified leads and determine when sales engagement can help convert or expand customer relationships. Establish a rigorous experimentation culture by developing hypotheses, launching tests, evaluating results, and scaling successful initiatives while discontinuing ineffective approaches. Track and report key growth indicators, including signup-to-activation rates, trial-to-paid conversion, self-serve revenue, expansion revenue, funnel velocity, and the quality of leads passed to sales. Align marketing, product, customer success, Revenue Operations, and sales teams around shared acquisition and growth objectives. Requirements: 5–8+ years of experience in growth, growth product management, lifecycle marketing, or funnel optimization roles. Proven success driving customer acquisition and managing growth funnels within B2B SaaS, developer-focused businesses, or companies with self-serve and product-led growth (PLG) models. Strong understanding of how developers discover, evaluate, adopt, and use technical products, with experience marketing or building solutions for technical audiences. Previous experience with developer tools, APIs, data products, or other technical platforms. Demonstrated ability to turn websites into effective demand-generation and conversion channels, with direct ownership of conversion performance rather than traffic alone. Track record of improving customer activation, free-to-paid conversion, expansion revenue, and customer retention while reducing churn. Strong analytical and data-driven approach, including defining metrics, instrumenting funnels, segmenting users, and combining product usage signals with targeted messaging and sales engagement. Experience as a Product Owner or Growth Product Manager, working closely with engineering and design teams to define requirements, prioritize initiatives, and deliver improvements iteratively. Practical experience using AI coding tools to prototype ideas, build mockups, and create working demos independently. Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to align product, marketing, customer success, Revenue Operations, and sales teams around shared goals. Curiosity about emerging AI technologies and how they are changing developer workflows, product discovery, and buying behavior. Production coding experience or contributions to open-source projects are considered an advantage. Familiarity with experimentation platforms, product analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or GA4, as well as marketing automation and CRM systems, is a plus. Experience developing product-qualified lead (PQL) strategies or platform-to-enterprise upgrade journeys is desirable. Benefits: Fully remote working e

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist – Applied ML & GenAI
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Lead model selection, feature engineering, and evaluation strategies across client projects and engagements. Translate business challenges into well-defined data science problems, establishing success metrics, data requirements, and robust validation methodologies. Develop, deploy, and maintain machine-learning models throughout their lifecycle, from initial experimentation to production monitoring and retraining. Monitor model performance, identify data and model drift, and implement appropriate improvements to maintain reliability and accuracy. Design reusable modelling approaches and frameworks that can be adapted across different industries and business contexts. Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs), embeddings, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities into solutions where relevant. Lead client discovery sessions, technical workshops, and presentations, communicating recommendations effectively to technical teams and senior stakeholders. Establish and promote best practices for model quality, reproducibility, responsible AI, and engineering standards. Mentor junior data scientists, support their technical development, and produce clear, comprehensive technical documentation. Collaborate with leadership and product development teams to align modelling initiatives with platform objectives and client needs. Requirements: At least 6 years of professional experience in data science or applied machine learning, with a proven track record of developing and deploying production-ready solutions using Python. Strong applied statistics expertise, including Bayesian inference, time-series forecasting, and causal inference. Advanced knowledge of feature engineering, model selection, cross-validation, bias-variance trade-offs, and model or data drift detection. Solid software engineering skills, including typed Python, pytest, and SQL, particularly with PostgreSQL. Familiarity with columnar databases such as ClickHouse is an advantage. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain, justify, and defend modelling decisions and results to non-technical audiences and executive stakeholders. Good understanding of data governance, information security, and regulatory compliance in client-facing environments. Hands-on experience with LLMs, embeddings, and RAG architectures, including prompt engineering and model fine-tuning, is highly desirable. Familiarity with vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, FAISS, or Azure AI Search is an advantage. Experience with service ownership and deployment technologies such as FastAPI, CI/CD pipelines, and schema migrations is beneficial. jobs.title: ML Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Develop, implement, and validate machine-learning models, training pipelines, inference systems, and supporting infrastructure. Build and improve model components, data pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and numerical computing methods. Create reproducible programmatic workflows using Python and command-line tools. Design, solve, review, and validate challenging machine-learning engineering tasks, ensuring solutions meet defined technical and performance requirements. Optimize model performance, memory usage, throughput, and computational efficiency. Investigate and resolve numerical, software, and system-level issues affecting model training or inference. Assess implementations for correctness, reliability, reproducibility, and alignment with project specifications. Requirements: BSc, MSc, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a closely related quantitative discipline. Strong professional or research experience in machine learning and practical ML engineering. Advanced Python programming skills and hands-on experience using coding agents. Demonstrated expertise in at least one of the following areas: inference and serving, model evaluation, data and feature engineering, retrieval/ranking/RAG, MLOps, model compression and optimization, or GPU/kernel optimization. Ability to develop, debug, and assess complex technical implementations independently. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to technical accuracy and measurable outcomes. Experience in a recognized technology company, AI laboratory, research organization, or established engineering environment is highly desirable. Exceptional academic contributions or open-source engineering experience may also be considered. Availability to begin promptly, with the ability to start the first task within 24–48 hours after completing onboarding if selected. Benefits: Competitive hourly compensation ranging from $60 to $120, depending on expertise and project requirements. Fully remote contractor opportunity, open to candidates globally. Flexible working arrangements, with the freedom to choose your working hours and days, including weekends. Part-time commitment of approximately 15 hours per week. Output-based compensation: payment is provided for tasks that meet the established project specifications, with task duration varying according to complexity and individual workflow. Opportunity to work on advanced AI training initiatives and challenging machine-learning engineering problems. Potential for a fast hiring process, with roles typically filled within approximately 48 hours. Opportunity to contribute independently while applying specialized technical knowledge to impactful AI development work.

jobs.title: Customer Support Agent (Spanish & English)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As a Customer Support Agent, you will manage a wide range of customer requests while ensuring accurate transactions, effective issue resolution, and consistently high service standards. You will also contribute to improving support operations and delivering a seamless customer experience. Respond to customer enquiries through multiple channels, including email and live chat, ensuring timely, accurate, and helpful responses. Investigate and resolve account and transaction issues, including failed buyouts, stuck casino rounds, and other gaming-related incidents. Handle manual credit tickets and cash transactions, ensuring accuracy and appropriate processing. Assess customer situations and process compensations when necessary, following established procedures. Support localization initiatives and translation activities to ensure clear and accurate communication for Spanish-speaking and other European customers. Regularly update FAQ content and support documentation to address recurring customer questions and improve self-service resources. Conduct quality checks and identify opportunities to enhance customer support processes and operational efficiency. Optimize the use of existing customer support tools to improve response times and service quality. Collaborate with internal teams to resolve complex issues and ensure compliance with applicable European regulatory requirements. Contribute to continuous improvements in the overall customer experience and customer satisfaction. Requirements: The ideal candidate has previous customer support experience in the online gambling industry, strong knowledge of poker, and excellent communication skills in both Spanish and English. You should be comfortable handling sensitive transactions, managing multiple requests, and making sound decisions in a fast-paced environment. Proven experience in customer support within the gambling or online gaming industry. In-depth knowledge of poker and a genuine passion for the game. Fluency in both Spanish and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically with customers. Experience handling customer complaints, troubleshooting issues, and resolving transaction-related problems. Strong attention to detail, particularly when managing manual credits, cash transactions, and customer compensations. Ability to multitask, prioritize requests, and make effective decisions under pressure. A customer-focused mindset with a proactive approach to problem-solving. Flexibility to work across European time zones, including evenings and weekends when required. Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with international teams. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement, with the flexibility to work from anywhere within the eligible European region. Full-time employment opportunities across Europe. Uncapped performance-based bonuses for top-performing employees. Quarterly performance reviews with opportunities for additional bonuses. Company-funded technology and home office setup budget. Monthly dedicated learning and development hours to support professional growth. Opportunities to attend industry conferences and professional events. Company meet-ups and opportunities to connect with colleagues in person. Dynamic international working environment with opportunities to develop industry expertise.

jobs.title: Lead Creative (Motion Design)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As the Lead Creative (Motion Design), you will oversee creative strategy, team development, and project execution while ensuring exceptional results for clients. You will foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement, balancing creative ambition with operational excellence. Lead, inspire, and develop a team of motion designers, driving creative excellence and innovation across projects. Define and own creative strategies, workflows, and project delivery, ensuring high-quality outputs within agreed timelines and budgets. Collaborate closely with dedicated account teams to strengthen customer relationships and support long-term client growth. Partner directly with global brands, presenting creative concepts, providing strategic direction, and building trust through outstanding creative work. Mentor team members, supporting their professional development, technical skills, and creative growth. Champion the adoption of emerging tools and technologies, particularly AI-powered solutions, to improve motion design workflows and creative outputs. Oversee multiple projects simultaneously, maintaining consistency, attention to detail, and exceptional production standards. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines strong creative vision, extensive motion design expertise, and proven leadership experience. You should be comfortable managing international creative teams, working directly with clients, and delivering high-quality work in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment. Bachelor's degree or higher in Design, Creative Arts, Communications, or a related field. At least 6 years of experience as a creative lead within a leading international creative agency or an in-house design team at a global technology company. A strong portfolio demonstrating outstanding motion design, animation, and creative direction capabilities. Proven experience leading high-performing creative teams and managing end-to-end creative projects. Advanced expertise in Adobe After Effects and Adobe Premiere Pro, with strong animation and video editing skills. Solid understanding of AI-assisted design and motion workflows, including tools such as Midjourney, Runway, and Krea. Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools into creative pipelines to enhance ideation, production, and delivery. Strong organizational skills, with the ability to quickly learn new processes and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Exceptional attention to detail and a consistent ability to deliver pixel-perfect creative work on time and within budget. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. A proactive, customer-centric mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Benefits: Fully remote work environment, with the flexibility to work from different locations worldwide. Opportunity to collaborate with an international team representing more than 60 nationalities. Exposure to leading global brands and diverse creative projects. High-trust, performance-driven culture that encourages direct feedback, continuous learning, and collaboration. Opportunities to influence creative strategy, contribute ideas, and shape the future of a growing global business. Access to mentorship, professional development, and meaningful leadership responsibilities. Opportunity to work with innovative creative technologies and help advance AI-powered design and production workflows. Inclusive and collaborative environment that values diversity, equal opportunities, and individual contributions.

jobs.title: Construction Back-Office & Project Coordination Virtual Assistant

jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will take responsibility for keeping construction projects and administrative workflows organized, ensuring that tasks are completed on time, communication remains clear, and financial and project records are accurate. jobs.title: Lead Generation & Growth Marketing Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will own the planning, execution, and optimization of lead-generation and growth marketing initiatives, ensuring that marketing activities translate into qualified prospects, stronger conversion rates, and measurable business opportunities. Develop and execute multi-channel lead-generation strategies to attract qualified prospects, increase conversions, and support business growth. Manage and optimize the complete lead-generation funnel, from traffic acquisition and lead capture to MQLs, SQLs, and sales opportunities. Take ownership of marketing initiatives from market research and strategy development through campaign planning, execution, testing, analysis, and optimization. Lead organic-first, multi-channel marketing programmes, coordinating SEO, PPC, content, design, and development specialists to achieve campaign objectives. Identify new growth opportunities through market research, competitor analysis, audience insights, and marketing performance data. Monitor and report on funnel performance, including website traffic, landing-page engagement, lead nurturing, qualification, and conversion. Plan and execute conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives to improve campaign effectiveness and lead-generation results. Improve website performance, organic visibility, user experience, and conversion rates through hands-on optimization and collaboration with relevant specialists. Support outbound marketing and account-based marketing initiatives in partnership with Sales and Business Development. Work closely with the sales team to gather feedback on lead quality, customer needs, and market trends, translating insights into more effective targeting and messaging. Use performance data and experimentation to continuously refine acquisition strategies and maximize pipeline contribution. Leverage AI-powered tools to improve research, content development, marketing analysis, and campaign workflows. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines strategic marketing expertise with hands-on execution and strong analytical capabilities. You should have experience generating qualified B2B leads in technology-driven markets, understand complex sales journeys, and be comfortable managing campaigns independently while coordinating cross-functional teams. At least 5 years of experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, or demand generation, with a proven track record of generating qualified leads and improving marketing performance. Experience in B2B software development, IT services, SaaS, or the broader technology sector, ideally involving complex buying journeys and longer sales cycles. At least 2 years of experience owning marketing campaigns or cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution and performance measurement. Strong understanding of multi-channel marketing, including content, email, social media, PPC, and conversion rate optimization. Working knowledge of SEO and GEO/AEO, including keyword research, search intent, and organic visibility strategies. Hands-on experience with analytics tools such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, Looker Studio, or equivalent platforms. Ability to connect marketing performance metrics with lead quality, sales pipeline, and revenue outcomes. Strong AI proficiency, including practical experience using AI tools for research, content creation, analysis, and campaign optimization. Solid understanding of audience targeting, positioning, and messaging, with the ability to develop compelling value propositions for different customer segments. Proactive, ownership-driven approach, with the ability to prioritize initiatives based on potential impact and move projects forward independently. Excellent communication and organizational skills, including the ability to coordinate specialists, provide clear feedback, and manage cross-functional collaboration. Fluent English proficiency (C1 level or higher). Nice to Have: Experience with marketing automation

jobs.title: Business Analyst – Master & Reference Data Management (MDM/RDM)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Take ownership of an existing Master Data Management proof of concept, coordinate knowledge transfer, identify outstanding requirements, and drive the solution through final implementation. Analyze sample-related data, structures, relationships, and workflows across multiple source systems. Define and validate business rules for matching, merging, deduplication, survivorship, and golden-record creation. Develop clear data mappings, functional requirements, acceptance criteria, and solution documentation. Collaborate with the Informatica MDM team on solution specifications, configuration clarifications, and issue resolution. Lead functional validation and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure the solution meets agreed business requirements. Coordinate delivery dependencies across business teams, Systems of Record (SoR) owners, integration teams, and central Data & Analytics stakeholders. Ensure requirements traceability, documentation, and testing comply with corporate Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards. Assess enterprise demand for Reference Data Management and collaborate with architecture teams to identify suitable long-term approaches. Requirements At least 5 years of experience in Business Analysis, Data Analysis, or related enterprise data-delivery roles. Strong practical understanding of Master Data Management concepts, including data models, matching and merging rules, deduplication, and golden records. Experience translating complex business processes across multiple systems into data definitions, mappings, and testable functional requirements. Proven ability to take ownership of an existing initiative and drive it through implementation, testing, and operational handover. Strong stakeholder-management, cross-functional coordination, and requirements-documentation skills. Experience working with structured SDLC delivery processes and conducting functional testing and UAT. Nice-to-have qualifications: Hands-on familiarity with Informatica MDM capabilities and configuration concepts. Knowledge of Reference Data Management strategy, governance, and reference-data standardization. Experience with Sample Management, scientific data, or pharmaceutical R&D workflows. Understanding of GxP or other regulated SDLC environments. Previous experience in a pharmaceutical research organization or a comparable environment. Benefits Engagement type: Freelance / contract. Work arrangement: Fully remote within Europe. Start date: ASAP, with immediate availability preferred. Project environment: Opportunity to contribute to enterprise MDM and RDM initiatives within a global pharmaceutical research environment. Scope of impact: Help transition an established MDM proof of concept into operational delivery and support the development of longer-term reference-data capabilities.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst – External Data Transfer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Own the intake, planning, coordination, and successful execution of external data-transfer requests. Lead requirements discussions with scientists, Business Technology Partners (BTPs), external vendors, and technical teams. Select appropriate transfer approaches and platforms, including MFT, MLFT, Globus, and Science Exchange. Incorporate GxP/GLP-related data-integrity requirements into delivery processes. Monitor delivery progress, risks, blockers, and dependencies across all participating teams. Consolidate previously fragmented transfer activities into a consistent, centrally managed operating model. Establish standardized, Jira-based processes for request intake, tracking, and documentation. Requirements At least 5 years of experience as a Senior Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or Technical Delivery Lead. Demonstrated ownership of cross-functional technical delivery involving multiple stakeholders. Experience coordinating technical engineers or analysts and prioritizing their activities. Working knowledge of file-transfer approaches such as MFT/MLFT, SFTP, or comparable managed transfer mechanisms. Familiarity with cloud storage technologies, particularly AWS S3. Ability to understand data-integrity validation methods, including checksums and file manifests. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to work effectively with business stakeholders and external technical partners. Nice-to-have qualifications: Direct experience with Globus or Science Exchange. Background in scientific research, pharmaceutical R&D, or external laboratory data transfers. Experience with GxP/GLP data integrity and regulated delivery environments. Familiarity with Aravo third-party risk assessment processes. Experience designing Jira-based intake workflows and standardizing services. Previous experience working with MSD/Merck. Benefits Engagement type: Freelance / contract. Work arrangement: Fully remote within Europe. Start date: ASAP, with immediate availability preferred. Project environment: Opportunity to support a global pharmaceutical organization and contribute to the development of a standardized enterprise data-transfer capability.

jobs.title: Product Manager – AI-First EdTech (PO / Technical BA welcome)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, gather requirements, and translate them into clear, actionable, development-ready tickets. Leverage AI tools to streamline product workflows, including drafting requirements, analyzing data, and improving documentation while maintaining high-quality outputs. Build clickable prototypes using AI-powered coding tools to test concepts, validate solutions, and gather feedback before development begins. Own and maintain a well-organized, prioritized product backlog and ensure the product roadmap remains accurate and aligned with business objectives. Define clear acceptance criteria and conduct feature acceptance testing to verify that deliverables meet requirements before release. Work closely with developers and QA specialists throughout the development lifecycle to coordinate implementation, testing, and successful releases. Analyze customer feedback and product usage data to identify improvement opportunities and guide future product decisions. Maintain accurate and up-to-date product documentation to ensure alignment and effective communication across stakeholders and technical teams. Proven ability to gather requirements, write clear user stories, define acceptance criteria, and translate business needs into technical specifications. Experience owning or conducting acceptance testing to ensure product features meet expectations before release. Daily, practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code, or similar solutions to improve productivity and support product-related tasks. Strong curiosity and willingness to explore new AI capabilities, particularly AI-assisted development and rapid prototyping. Experience working in Agile development environments using tools such as Jira and Confluence. Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and communicate technical concepts and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in an international remote environment. Opportunity to work on a meaningful product that helps healthcare professionals maintain their knowledge, skills, and professional certifications. jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Execute comprehensive manual regression test cycles on iOS and Android release candidates across a range of supported devices and operating systems. Experience managing or supporting complete regression testing cycles within scheduled release environments. Strong exploratory testing capabilities, including session-based, risk-prioritized, and well-documented testing approaches. Familiarity with test management and bug-tracking tools such as TestRail, Xray, Zephyr, Jira, Shortcut, or Notion. Experience conducting real-device testing through BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, or similar platforms. Excellent written English and asynchronous communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across international time zones. Nice to have: Experience with automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, WebdriverIO, or Appium. Nice to have: Basic proficiency in one or more programming languages, including Java, C#, JavaScript, Python, or Go. Nice to have: Previous experience testing cryptocurrency wallets, DeFi platforms, fintech applications, or products handling sensitive financial and user data. Nice to have: Exposure to containerized or cloud-based testing infrastructure and browser extension testing across Chrome, Firefox, or Brave. Nice to have: Familiarity with log and network inspection tools such as Charles Proxy, Xcode Instruments, and Android Studio Logcat. Nice to have: Understanding of release management workflows and release candidate gating processes. Benefits: Competitive salary and benefits package. Excellent learning, professional development, and career growth opportunities. Exposure to fast-paced, challenging, and innovative projects within the blockchain and Web3 ecosystem. Opportunity to contribute to products shaping the future of decentralized finance and digital asset management. International and collaborative working environment with a relatively flat organizational structure. jobs.title: Business Development Manager (Freelance - B2B)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Identify, research, and generate new B2B business opportunities across international markets and multiple industry sectors. Proactively approach companies with current or anticipated recruitment, staffing, and talent acquisition needs. Develop commercial opportunities across sectors including Hospitality, iGaming, Fintech, E-Mobility, Healthcare, Finance and Accounting, Technology, BPO, and other relevant industries. Leverage your existing professional network, industry relationships, and business development experience to introduce potential clients and generate qualified leads. Identify and engage key decision-makers, including HR Directors, Talent Acquisition Leaders, Hiring Managers, and senior executives. Initiate commercial conversations, present recruitment and staffing solutions, and communicate the value of potential partnerships. Qualify prospective clients by understanding their recruitment requirements, hiring volumes, business objectives, and potential collaboration opportunities. Facilitate introductions between qualified prospects and the internal recruitment team to support the development and conversion of commercial opportunities. Build, manage, and continuously develop a strong pipeline of prospective clients across different industries and geographical markets. Establish and nurture long-term business relationships to create recurring commercial opportunities and sustainable revenue streams. Independently define and execute outreach strategies, target markets, prospecting activities, and business development priorities. Monitor market opportunities and industry developments to identify potential clients and expand commercial reach. Collaborate with internal recruitment and delivery teams to ensure a smooth transition from initial client engagement to successful commercial partnerships. Requirements: Minimum 3 years of professional experience in B2B Business Development, Sales, Lead Generation, or a related commercial role. Strong understanding of B2B sales processes, prospecting methodologies, lead qualification, and relationship management. An established professional network or direct access to business decision-makers within one or more relevant industries is a significant advantage. Previous experience identifying new business opportunities and developing commercial relationships across international markets. Confidence in approaching companies, presenting business propositions, and initiating discussions with senior decision-makers. Excellent communication, negotiation, networking, and relationship-building skills. Strong commercial awareness and the ability to identify client needs and translate them into potential business opportunities. Entrepreneurial mindset, with a proactive and results-oriented approach to generating new business. Ability to work independently, manage your own prospecting activities, and take full ownership of business development objectives. Strong organizational and pipeline management skills, with the ability to prioritize opportunities and maintain consistent outreach. Professional proficiency in English is essential. Additional languages are highly valued. Comfortable working under a fully commission-based freelance arrangement without a fixed salary. Self-motivated and commercially driven, with the ability to build a long-term independent business development partnership. Previous experience in recruitment, staffing, HR services, or talent acquisition is beneficial. Flexibility and adaptability to work across different industries, markets, and international business environments. Benefits: Fully remote freelance collaboration, open to professionals based anywhere in the world. Complete working flexibility, allowing you to determine your own schedule, geographical markets, target industries, and outreach strategy. Attractive uncapped commission structure, with commission terms agreed in advance for successfully converted client leads. Unlimited earning po

jobs.title: SMS Routing Specialist / Telecom Traffic Analyst
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Identify, research, test, and evaluate SMS A2P routes that meet customer requirements, including A2P and OTP traffic delivery. Expand the global SMS supplier network by identifying suitable providers and supporting supplier evaluation and onboarding. Monitor and analyse traffic quality using key performance indicators such as delivery receipt rates (DLR), conversion rates, and delivery speed. Evaluate the price-to-quality ratio of existing and potential routes to ensure competitive and reliable service. Optimise existing routing strategies to reduce delivery costs, improve margins, and maintain traffic quality. Prepare regular reports on route performance, traffic quality, and operational statistics. Use Excel to analyse traffic data, build reports, create pivot tables, and identify performance trends and improvement opportunities. Develop commercial proposals that reflect customer requirements, pricing expectations, and available routing options. Apply market knowledge and commercial judgment to support supplier negotiations and improve the competitiveness of the SMS offering. Requirements: 3–5 years of professional experience in the A2P SMS industry is essential. Proven experience identifying, evaluating, and onboarding SMS suppliers is essential. Strong understanding of SMS traffic management and routing, including experience with iGaming traffic. Good knowledge of global SMS markets, supplier dynamics, pricing structures, and commercial trends. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to assess route performance, interpret traffic statistics, and evaluate cost and quality. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including reporting, pivot tables, and statistical analysis. Strong negotiation and commercial skills, with the ability to assess supplier offers and develop competitive proposals. Fluent English, both written and spoken, with the ability to communicate effectively in an international business environment. A proactive, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work effectively in a fast-moving, internationally focused team. Benefits: Competitive compensation: Attractive compensation package. International exposure: Opportunity to work with a global team and gain experience across international telecommunications markets. Professional development: Build and deepen expertise in the fast-growing A2P SMS and telecom routing industry. High-impact responsibilities: Direct contribution to revenue growth, operational efficiency, supplier network expansion, and business performance. Dynamic environment: Join an energetic, fast-paced organisation experiencing significant growth and transformation. Collaborative culture: Work alongside passionate colleagues in an international and supportive team. Opportunity to make an impact: Help shape routing strategies and contribute to the development of the global messaging ecosystem.

Expand the global SMS supplier network by identifying suitable providers and supporting supplier evaluation and onboarding. Monitor and analyse traffic quality using key performance indicators such as delivery receipt rates (DLR), conversion rates, and delivery speed. Evaluate the price-to-quality ratio of existing and potential routes to ensure competitive and reliable service. Optimise existing routing strategies to reduce delivery costs, improve margins, and maintain traffic quality. Prepare regular reports on route performance, traffic quality, and operational statistics. Use Excel to analyse traffic data, build reports, create pivot tables, and identify performance trends and improvement opportunities. Develop commercial proposals that reflect customer requirements, pricing expectations, and available routing options. Apply market knowledge and commercial judgment to support supplier negotiations and improve the competitiveness of the SMS offering. Requirements: 3–5 years of professional experience in the A2P SMS industry is essential. Proven experience identifying, evaluating, and onboarding SMS suppliers is essential. Strong understanding of SMS traffic management and routing, including experience with iGaming traffic. Good knowledge of global SMS markets, supplier dynamics, pricing structures, and commercial trends. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to assess route performance, interpret traffic statistics, and evaluate cost and quality. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including reporting, pivot tables, and statistical analysis. Strong negotiation and commercial skills, with the ability to assess supplier offers and develop competitive proposals. Fluent English, both written and spoken, with the ability to communicate effectively in an international business environment. A proactive, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work effectively in a fast-moving, internationally focused team. Benefits: Competitive compensation: Attractive compensation package. International exposure: Opportunity to work with a global team and gain experience across international telecommunications markets. Professional development: Build and deepen expertise in the fast-growing A2P SMS and telecom routing industry. High-impact responsibilities: Direct contribution to revenue growth, operational efficiency, supplier network expansion, and business performance. Dynamic environment: Join an energetic, fast-paced organisation experiencing significant growth and transformation. Collaborative culture: Work alongside passionate colleagues in an international and supportive team. Opportunity to make an impact: Help shape routing strategies and contribute to the development of the global messaging ecosystem.

jobs.title: Senior Performance Strategist
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Bring performance data, campaign insights, and historical results into the strategic briefing process to ensure creative decisions are grounded in audience behaviour and evidence. Lead performance-focused projects by identifying opportunities in the data, defining strategic direction, and briefing creative teams. Translate campaign concepts into actionable in-market plans across channels, formats, and audience segments. Design creative testing roadmaps and measurement frameworks, including test planning and tracking requirements. Analyse creative performance to understand what is working, what is underperforming, and the reasons behind campaign outcomes. Drive ongoing creative optimisation by scaling successful concepts, improving underperforming assets, and supporting audience progression through the marketing funnel. Turn performance results into clear recommendations on what to scale, stop, or test next. Act as a trusted strategic partner to senior client stakeholders, presenting insights, performance results, and recommendations with confidence. Identify opportunities for account growth through continuous optimisation programmes and new performance-focused offerings. Apply an AI-native mindset throughout the strategic process, exploring ways to improve analysis, creative development, and operational workflows. Partner with the product team to develop new performance creative solutions, scalable workflows, and offerings that extend beyond existing tools and capabilities. Share insights and best practices across teams, helping strengthen the connection between creative strategy and performance outcomes. Requirements: 7+ years of experience in performance or growth strategy within an agency or brand environment, with a strong focus on performance creative. Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex performance strategy engagements and influence senior client stakeholders and creative leaders. Proven experience designing and managing creative testing programmes that have delivered measurable performance improvements. Strong analytical capabilities across major advertising platforms, with a working understanding of attribution, measurement, and campaign performance. Full-funnel experience spanning paid social, customer acquisition, and conversion. Ability to identify creative opportunities through data analysis and translate insights into clear, actionable briefs that inspire creative teams. Strong understanding of how brand-building and performance marketing complement one another. Genuine curiosity about emerging technologies, with experience experimenting with or developing new tools, processes, or workflows. Excellent communication and presentation skills, including experience advising and presenting recommendations directly to senior clients. A collaborative mindset, intellectual curiosity, and commitment to continuously developing strategic expertise. Benefits: Remote-first work environment: Fully remote company culture, with the flexibility to collaborate across time zones. Global team: Opportunity to work alongside colleagues from more than 60 nationalities and across diverse cultures and disciplines. Meaningful impact: Contribute to work for ambitious global brands and help shape the future of performance creative. High-trust culture: Fast-paced environment built around direct feedback, collaboration, continuous learning, and low-ego teamwork. Career development: Access to mentorship, meaningful responsibility, and opportunities to grow professionally and take on leadership challenges. Opportunity to influence: Join a growing organisation where individual ideas and contributions can shape new services, workflows, and strategic direction.

jobs.title: Customer Success Director
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Own customer revenue, retention, and expansion across a portfolio of strategic accounts, ensuring commercial objectives and customer outcomes remain aligned. Proactively identify growth opportunities, customer risks, and early churn signals, translating insights into clear actions and measurable results. Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders, positioning the business as a strategic partner rather than simply a service provider. Lead strategic account planning, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), commercial discussions, and major customer escalations. Ensure each strategic account has clearly defined objectives, accountable owners, customer health indicators, and a structured success plan. Lead, coach, and develop the Customer Success team, fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, and high performance. Collaborate with Business Development, Product, Data, Operations, and AI/Automation teams to resolve customer challenges and deliver on commitments. Design and implement scalable Customer Success processes covering onboarding, account health, reporting, customer lifecycle management, and churn prevention. Leverage CRM systems, data, and AI-powered automation to improve visibility, streamline workflows, and allow the team to focus on high-value customer interactions. Act as the voice of the customer, bringing feedback and insights into product development, commercial strategy, and operational priorities. Requirements: 10+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Strategic Accounts, or a comparable commercial leadership role. Proven track record of owning and improving customer revenue, retention, and/or account expansion. Demonstrated experience managing high-value or enterprise customers and building strong relationships with senior stakeholders and executive decision-makers. Previous people leadership experience, including the ability to coach, challenge, motivate, and develop high-performing teams. Strong commercial judgment and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret account performance, identify opportunities, and address customer risks. Excellent communication, negotiation, relationship-building, and stakeholder-management skills. A strong ownership mindset, proactive approach, and ability to make sound decisions in a fast-moving environment where priorities may change. Preferred qualifications: Hands-on experience with CRM or Customer Success platforms, along with an interest in AI, automation, and technology-enabled approaches to Customer Success. Candidates who do not meet every listed preference are still encouraged to apply if they bring relevant experience and the ability to make an impact. Benefits: Work arrangement: Fully remote, with the flexibility to work from anywhere. Employment type: Part-time leadership opportunity. Strategic ownership: Direct responsibility for customer revenue, retention, account growth, and team performance. Opportunity to shape the function: Play a central role in defining and developing the Customer Success strategy and operating model as the organization grows. AI-first environment: Work within a business built around seven specialized AI agents, with data and automation integrated into everyday operations. Cross-functional impact: Collaborate with teams across Business Development, Product, Data, Operations, and AI/Automation.

Experiment with different AI tools, prompting techniques, and creative approaches to achieve desired results. Edit, refine, and optimize AI-generated images and videos to ensure quality, consistency, and visual appeal. Stay informed about emerging AI content creation technologies, tools, and visual trends. Strong attention to detail and ability to follow creative instructions and brand guidelines. Upper-intermediate English proficiency (B2 level). Benefits : Fully remote working opportunity. Full-time employment. Competitive salary. Opportunity to work with innovative AI content creation technologies. Exposure to emerging trends and tools in AI-powered visual marketing.

jobs.title: RT Business Analyst – Real-Time Process Monitoring & Analytics
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Lead requirements-gathering workshops, stakeholder interviews, discovery sessions, and business process analysis activities. Analyze and document existing (AS-IS) and future-state (TO-BE) laboratory and manufacturing workflows. Gather, define, and document functional, non-functional, data, integration, reporting, security, and compliance requirements. Create business process diagrams, BPMN models, swimlane diagrams, data-flow diagrams, and requirements traceability matrices. Translate business and scientific needs into Jira epics, features, user stories, functional specifications, and clearly defined acceptance criteria. Map and document data flows between laboratory instruments, manufacturing systems, real-time process monitoring solutions, and enterprise data platforms. Collaborate with scientists, laboratory users, solution architects, developers, product owners, and external technology vendors. Identify process inefficiencies, technical dependencies, integration gaps, operational risks, and opportunities for automation and improvement. Support solution assessments, backlog prioritization, implementation planning, and project delivery activities. Contribute to testing activities, including User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and ensure requirements are properly validated. Ensure that documented requirements and proposed solutions align with pharmaceutical compliance, validation, and data integrity standards. Produce key project deliverables, including process documentation, requirements specifications, integration inventories, decision logs, risk assessments, prioritized backlogs, UAT scenarios, and operational handover documentation. Requirements: At least 5 years of professional experience as a Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, or Product Analyst in complex technology environments. Strong hands-on experience in business requirements elicitation, analysis, documentation, and stakeholder management. Demonstrated ability to analyze complex business workflows and translate business needs into actionable technical requirements. Experience with business process modeling methodologies, including BPMN, SIPOC, swimlane diagrams, or equivalent approaches. Ability to document system integrations, data flows, business rules, systems of record, and non-functional requirements. Experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, and requirements traceability documentation. Strong working knowledge of Jira, Confluence, and Agile/Scrum methodologies. Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Excellent analytical thinking, problem-solving, communication, workshop facilitation, and documentation skills. Professional working proficiency in English. Experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, biotechnology, bioprocessing, laboratory automation, or scientific data management is highly desirable. Understanding of Process Analytical Technology (PAT), real-time process monitoring, cell health analysis, and potency assays is an advantage. Familiarity with laboratory instruments, manufacturing equipment, scientific workflows, and time-series data is beneficial. Knowledge of regulated environments, including GxP, Computerized System Validation (CSV), audit trails, and data integrity requirements, is preferred. Familiarity with industrial automation and integration technologies such as Ignition, OPC UA, and DeltaV is a plus. Exposure to cloud-based data platforms and analytics technologies, including Databricks, Python, and MLOps, is advantageous. Experience with manufacturing systems, laboratory data integration, industrial data pipelines, architecture assessments, vendor evaluations, or digital transformation projects is desirable. Hands-on development experience with the technologies mentioned is not mandatory; the priority is the ability to understand complex scientific and technical concepts and translate them into clear requirements. jobs.title: Ignition Developer – Industrial & Laboratory Automation
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Design, develop, maintain, and support Ignition Perspective and Vision applications, including SCADA dashboards, operator interfaces, alarm management, reporting, and real-time visualization. Integrate Ignition with PLCs, Distributed Control Systems (DCS), laboratory instruments, analyzers, robotics, process historians, SQL databases, and enterprise platforms. Develop and implement automated workflows, including recipe-driven processes, automated sampling and feeding, process orchestration, equipment-state monitoring, and event-driven automation. Configure and manage Ignition Tags, User-Defined Types (UDTs), Tag Historian, alarms, security roles, gateway services, and reporting modules. Build connectivity and data exchange solutions using OPC UA, MQTT/Sparkplug, REST APIs, SQL, message queues, and file-based interfaces. Develop reusable automation components and follow software engineering best practices, including version control, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, and structured release management. Troubleshoot and resolve gateway, application, database, networking, and integration issues while ensuring system reliability and compliance with industrial cybersecurity standards. Collaborate with scientists, automation engineers, quality teams, vendors, and system integrators to deliver robust and efficient automation solutions. Requirements: At least 5 years of professional experience in industrial automation, SCADA, manufacturing systems, or laboratory automation. Hands-on experience developing applications with the Inductive Automation Ignition Platform, particularly Perspective and/or Vision. Strong knowledge of Ignition Tag configuration, UDTs, alarming, historization, reporting, gateway administration, security, and scripting. Proficiency in Python/Jython scripting and SQL. Practical experience with industrial system integration technologies, including OPC UA, MQTT/Sparkplug, REST APIs, message queues, and file-based data exchange. Experience connecting and integrating PLCs, DCS, laboratory instruments, analyzers, robotics, or other industrial equipment. Understanding of industrial networking, secure connectivity, certificates, service accounts, and gateway architecture. Familiarity with Git, code reviews, CI/CD practices, and structured software release processes. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with professional proficiency in English. Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, laboratory, or regulated manufacturing environments is highly desirable. Knowledge of ISA-88, ISA-95, GxP, data integrity, audit trails, Computer System Validation (CSV), and change control is an advantage. Familiarity with DeltaV, process historians, laboratory informatics systems, scientific data platforms, or Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) is preferred. Understanding of time-series data, real-time analytics, store-and-forward architectures, and process monitoring is beneficial. Experience with laboratory automation, bioreactors, robotics, or automated manufacturing workflows is an advantage. Ignition certification or equivalent demonstrable platform expertise is desirable. Benefits: Freelance / contract engagement with an international project environment. Fully remote working opportunity within Europe. Opportunity to contribute to projects in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, laboratory systems, and real-time analytics. Exposure to advanced industrial automation technologies and complex laboratory digitalization initiatives. Collaboration with multidisciplinary international teams, including automation engineers, scientists, architects, and data specialists. Opportunity to work on impactful projects involving bioreactor modernization, integrated manufacturing workflows, and process optimization. Start date: ASAP, with immediate availability preferred. Engagement type: Freelance / Contract.

jobs.title: NLP Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Language Model Development: Train, fine-tune, and improve language models used in AI-powered conversational assistants and copilots. Adapt models to new conversation scenarios, response requirements, and structured output formats. Dataset Preparation and Management: Build, prepare, and maintain high-quality training and evaluation datasets. Identify data gaps, analyze model errors, define annotation requirements, and review annotated examples to improve model performance. Model Selection and Prompt Engineering: Evaluate and compare internally hosted language models with external model APIs, assessing response quality, latency, reliability, and cost-effectiveness. Develop and optimize prompts to achieve consistent and relevant outputs. Model Evaluation and Benchmarking: Maintain evaluation datasets and performance benchmarks, using automated assessments, human reviews, and other evaluation techniques to measure generated text quality. Identify regressions, investigate unsatisfactory responses, and incorporate user feedback into improvements. Model Deployment and API Development: Build, package, and maintain services and APIs around language models using FastAPI or comparable frameworks. Support reliable deployment and integration of models into production applications. Inference Optimization: Improve model inference speed, GPU memory utilization, and serving costs while maintaining the required response quality and performance standards. Production Monitoring and Troubleshooting: Implement logging, monitoring, and appropriate testing processes to maintain production reliability. Investigate technical issues, manage deployment failures, and support rollback procedures when necessary. Recommendation Systems: Contribute to recommendation-related capabilities and explore opportunities to apply NLP and machine learning techniques to improve product experiences. Technical Documentation: Maintain reproducible experiments, document technical decisions and results, and ensure solutions are understandable and maintainable by other engineering team members. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with engineering and product stakeholders to translate requirements into effective NLP solutions and deliver improvements to AI-powered features. Requirements: Strong proficiency in Python, with experience writing clean, maintainable, production-quality code beyond research notebooks. Practical experience with PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers, including a solid understanding of transformer architectures, tokenization, model training, and text generation. Hands-on experience adapting and fine-tuning language models through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and parameter-efficient approaches such as LoRA. Strong understanding of dataset preparation, validation, quality control, and data leakage prevention. Ability to investigate model errors, identify weaknesses in training data, and develop strategies to improve model performance. Experience evaluating generated text using benchmarks, automated evaluation methods, and human review. Understanding of the strengths, limitations, and trade-offs of different language models and evaluation approaches. Practical experience working with model APIs, prompt engineering, and structured output generation. Experience developing and maintaining APIs using FastAPI or an equivalent backend framework. Familiarity with Docker, Linux, and Git, including experience deploying machine learning models on GPU infrastructure. Knowledge of model inference and serving frameworks such as vLLM or equivalent technologies. Experience implementing logging, monitoring, automated tests, and production troubleshooting procedures. Ability to investigate production failures, identify root causes, and manage safe release or rollback processes. SQL proficiency sufficient to retrieve, query, and analyze product data. jobs.title: Email & CRM Marketing Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Campaign Management: Plan, build, execute, and optimize multi-channel CRM campaigns across email, SMS, push notifications, and in-app messaging to strengthen customer engagement, activation, and retention. Lifecycle Marketing: Develop and manage communication strategies for existing customers, creating relevant touchpoints throughout the customer journey. Customer Segmentation and Personalization: Analyze customer behavior and segment databases to deliver targeted, personalized communications based on user preferences, activity, and engagement patterns across different markets. Testing and Optimization: Continuously conduct A/B tests and experiments involving messaging, copywriting, design, audience segments, timing, and communication channels to improve campaign effectiveness. Performance Monitoring and Reporting: Track and analyze key marketing performance indicators, including open rates, click-through rates, engagement, and retention metrics. Prepare regular performance reports and recommend actionable improvements. Deliverability Management: Monitor email deliverability, maintain sender reputation, and implement best practices to ensure successful campaign delivery. CRM Platform Management: Use Customer.io and other customer engagement technologies to manage automated workflows, campaign execution, audience segmentation, and lifecycle communications. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with marketing, design, and content teams to develop consistent messaging and deliver coordinated CRM initiatives. Continuous Improvement: Stay informed about digital marketing trends, emerging technologies, and AI-powered marketing solutions to identify opportunities for innovation and improved campaign performance. Requirements: At least 3 years of professional experience as a CRM Manager, Email Marketing Manager, or in a similar B2C CRM marketing position. Previous experience in the iGaming industry is considered a strong advantage. Strong understanding of marketing performance metrics and customer engagement indicators across the entire customer lifecycle. Hands-on experience with customer engagement platforms, preferably Customer.io, and the ability to manage automated campaigns and communication workflows. Good understanding of customer segmentation, audience targeting, logical operators, and personalized communication strategies. Strong technical knowledge of HTML and APIs, with the ability to support CRM integrations and campaign implementation. Experience planning, executing, and optimizing multi-channel campaigns across email, SMS, push notifications, and in-app messaging. Ability to analyze campaign performance data, identify improvement opportunities, and translate insights into effective marketing actions. Knowledge of email deliverability best practices and sender reputation management. A customer-centric and results-oriented mindset, with a strong focus on engagement, retention, and continuous optimization. Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, combined with attention to detail. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in an international team. Upper-intermediate English proficiency or higher. Familiarity with AI-powered marketing tools and technologies is a significant advantage. Curiosity about emerging digital marketing trends and a proactive approach to learning and professional development. Benefits: Competitive Compensation: Attractive salary package aligned with experience and expertise. Remote Work: Flexibility to work remotely, offering greater freedom over your working environment. Flexible Working Hours: Adaptable working arrangements that support autonomy and work-life balance. Generous Time Off: Comprehensive vacation and sick leave policies. Health Insurance: Health coverage designed to support employee well-being. Professional Development: Financial assistance for professional development and access to educational

jobs.title: Middle Software Engineer - Backend (Platform)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As part of the backend engineering team, you will develop and maintain scalable services while contributing to technical design, deployment practices, and operational excellence. You will collaborate across teams, take ownership of assigned changes, and help ensure that services remain reliable, maintainable, and compatible as the platform evolves. Implement backend services within high-performance, distributed systems, working with senior engineers on complex technical decisions. Contribute to service architecture and API development for internal teams and external integrations, ensuring appropriate communication guarantees, idempotency, and backward compatibility. Apply modern engineering practices, including test-driven and behavior-driven development where appropriate. Write clean, maintainable code supported by meaningful unit and integration tests. Integrate AI tools into the development workflow, critically reviewing and validating generated output. Collaborate with cross-functional teams in a product-oriented environment. Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and incorporate suggestions from colleagues. Document service behavior, design decisions, and operational considerations. Own assigned changes throughout implementation, testing, deployment, and production verification, including canary releases. Build observability into services and contribute to diagnosing and resolving production incidents. Requirements : You bring a solid foundation in backend engineering and practical experience developing reliable services with Java and distributed systems. You are comfortable working with databases, messaging technologies, deployment pipelines, and testing practices, and you can balance independent problem-solving with effective collaboration. Proficiency in Java and a good understanding of backend architecture, API design, and scalability fundamentals. Familiarity with distributed systems, including concurrency, error handling, and retry mechanisms. Practical knowledge of PostgreSQL, including query optimization, indexing, and data modeling. Understanding of microservice architecture and synchronous and asynchronous service communication, particularly with Apache Kafka. Knowledge of message publishing, delivery guarantees, durability, and idempotency. Working knowledge of CI/CD workflows and experience using existing pipelines to deploy changes. Basic hands-on experience with canary deployments and an understanding of their operational constraints, including backward-compatible changes when multiple service versions coexist. Experience diagnosing and resolving production incidents, with an understanding of alerts, metrics, logs, and observability. Ability to instrument application code and understand how telemetry is collected, delivered, and aggregated across different sources. Practical experience writing unit and integration tests, with sound judgment about what to test and at which level. Regular experience using AI-assisted development tools, including the ability to select appropriate tasks for AI and validate its output. Interest in the payments industry, particularly payment routing, retries, and subscriptions, is an advantage. Technology Stack: Java 21+ Docker Apache Kafka Spring Framework 6.x Spring Boot 3.x PostgreSQL ClickHouse Gradle GitLab Benefits : Flexible work arrangements: Work remotely from a location of your choice, with access to office and coworking spaces where available. Flexible working hours: Organize your schedule with a start time between 8:00 and 11:00 and a finish time between 17:00 and 20:00, while respecting team collaboration hours. Professional development: Access courses, conferences, an internal learning library, and English lessons. Healthcare and wellbeing: Medical insurance, a mental health program, and compensation for sessions with a psychologist. Paid time off: 28 paid days off annually, sick leave, and fully covered public holidays. Techni

jobs.title: Content Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Create and manage engaging digital content that supports users throughout their well-being journeys. You will contribute to the development of new content experiences, leverage AI tools to streamline production, and ensure all materials are accurately implemented and tested before release. Develop engaging in-app lessons based on content topics, advertising creatives, user requests, feedback, and identified customer pain points. Collaborate with your manager to create relevant content that improves user engagement and helps reduce subscription cancellations. Write clear, engaging, and accessible English-language content tailored to the platform's audience and objectives. Ensure all content is accurately uploaded and configured within the content management system. Test different user journeys and content flows to identify potential issues and ensure a smooth experience before new releases. Introduce and develop new in-app content formats, including quizzes, practical exercises, and interactive experiences. Coordinate the operational implementation of new content formats, ensuring all materials are properly created and integrated into the content system with support from the team. Produce videos for the application in accordance with the established content calendar and creative guidelines. Leverage existing AI tools and workflows, including Claude, to support video creation and improve content production efficiency. Continuously explore opportunities to improve content quality, variety, and effectiveness through experimentation with AI-powered solutions. Requirements : The ideal candidate combines strong English writing abilities with practical experience in digital content creation, AI-powered tools, or content management systems. You should be comfortable experimenting with new technologies, working independently, and managing content production tasks with accuracy and attention to detail. English proficiency at B2 level or higher, with the ability to create clear, engaging written content in English from day one. Previous experience writing English-language content. A portfolio is welcome but not mandatory. Regular hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or comparable platforms to create content. Ability to provide 2–3 examples of AI-assisted work, explaining the prompts used, the content produced, and the final results. Alternatively, experience developing personalized AI workflows, including prompt templates, projects, or custom assistants for text or video production. Experience working with a content management system (CMS), administrative panel, or similar platform for uploading and managing digital content. Alternatively, practical experience creating or editing videos using traditional software or AI-powered tools. Strong writing, communication, and organizational skills. Attention to detail and the ability to review content, identify errors, and ensure accuracy before publication. Creativity and curiosity, with an interest in experimenting with new content formats and technologies. Ability to collaborate effectively while taking ownership of assigned responsibilities. Nice-to-have qualifications: Previous experience working in a digital product company. Experience creating different types of content from scratch, including videos, assessments, quizzes, and practical exercises. Previous experience in the wellness or mental health industry. Academic or professional background in psychology or a related discipline. Genuine interest in mental health, personal development, and improving people's well-being. Benefits : Fully remote working opportunity. Opportunity to contribute to digital well-being products with a global audience. Hands-on experience using advanced AI tools for content and video production. Exposure to innovative content formats and AI-powered product experiences. Opportunity to take ownership of creative projects and contribute new ideas. Collaborative environment
