jobs.title: Senior Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Own and lead end-to-end compliance programs and audit processes covering SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 42001, GDPR, and HIPAA/HITECH. Plan and coordinate audits, manage evidence collection, maintain documentation, and ensure audit readiness and timely delivery of required materials. Serve as a primary point of contact for external auditors, customers, and prospective clients on information security and compliance matters. Lead enterprise customer security discussions, including in-depth security reviews, assessments, and questionnaire responses. Oversee internal and external security assessments across systems, services, and organizational teams. Manage and continuously improve the Third-Party Risk Management program, including the assessment and ongoing monitoring of vendors and business partners. Maintain, enhance, and scale security controls, governance practices, and compliance processes throughout the organization. Collaborate with engineering and product teams to translate regulatory and security requirements into practical technical and operational implementations. Track remediation activities, coordinate responsible stakeholders, and ensure identified gaps are resolved within agreed timelines. Prepare and present audit findings, compliance updates, and risk reports to internal stakeholders and senior leadership. Promote security awareness across teams and provide strategic guidance on emerging regulatory requirements, industry standards, and compliance trends. Requirements: 6+ years of experience in Information Security, Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC), auditing, or risk management. Strong practical knowledge of security and compliance frameworks, particularly SOC 2, PCI DSS, GDPR, and HIPAA/HITECH. Demonstrated experience independently owning and leading audits and compliance initiatives from planning through completion. Experience working with cloud-based environments and distributed systems; AWS experience is preferred. Strong project management and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to coordinate multiple concurrent initiatives. Excellent analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills, supported by a proactive and solution-oriented mindset. Ability to translate complex security, risk, and compliance requirements into clear documentation and accessible business language. Strong communication and relationship-building skills, including experience engaging technical teams, external auditors, enterprise customers, and other stakeholders. High degree of curiosity, adaptability, initiative, and ownership when addressing evolving security challenges. Excellent written and spoken English. Relevant professional certifications are strongly preferred, including one or more of the following: CISA, CISM, CRISC, CISSP, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor, or ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Auditor. Experience implementing ISO/IEC 27001 is an additional advantage. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement within Europe. Full-time employment. Opportunity to take ownership of strategic security and compliance programs. High-impact role contributing directly to customer trust, enterprise security, and organizational growth. Collaboration with international teams across engineering, product, security, and leadership. Professional development through exposure to evolving security frameworks, regulatory requirements, and emerging compliance practices. Equal-opportunity and inclusive recruitment environment.

jobs.title: SDR Manager International
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Lead and manage the international SDR team, initially comprising four representatives and expected to grow to seven by the end of Q1 2027. Own team pipeline performance, focusing on increasing the volume of high-value opportunities worth $100K or more and improving conversion across the sales funnel. Coach SDRs through regular call reviews, email reviews, and deal debriefs, providing actionable feedback to strengthen performance. Establish clear expectations and ensure accountability for activity levels, conversion rates, quota attainment, and pipeline quality. Monitor performance metrics, identify gaps, and connect SDR activities to pipeline generation and revenue outcomes. Develop and scale effective inbound and outbound sales development processes that align with Account Executive requirements. Recruit, onboard, train, and ramp new SDRs while supporting their ongoing professional development and career progression. Collaborate with Marketing, Account Executives, Revenue Operations, and Sales Leadership to improve lead generation, qualification, and sales execution. Shape and optimize sales development strategies across multiple European markets and cultural environments. Requirements: 5+ years of professional sales experience, including at least 3 years managing Sales Development Representative teams. Previous success in a quota-carrying SDR and/or Account Executive role. Demonstrated experience managing sales representatives across multiple markets and cultural contexts. Proven ability to recruit, onboard, train, and develop SDRs through structured and repeatable processes. Strong analytical and metrics-driven approach to performance management, pipeline tracking, and continuous improvement. Ability to translate sales activity data into actionable insights that improve conversion and revenue contribution. Strong coaching and leadership skills, with the ability to deliver direct feedback in an empathetic, fair, and constructive manner. Fluency in English and at least one additional language: German (preferred), French, or Spanish. Familiarity with sales development and revenue tools such as Amplemarket, Orum, Gong, and HubSpot. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across international and cross-functional teams. Benefits: Competitive European base salary of €60,000–€80,000, plus €26,000–€34,000 commission. On-target earnings (OTE) of €86,000–€114,000. Equity participation. Fully remote working arrangement, with availability during EMEA time zones. Unlimited paid time off. 12–16 weeks of paid parental leave. Opportunity to build and lead a growing international sales development team. High-impact role with direct influence on pipeline generation and broader revenue objectives. Remote-first, documentation-focused working culture designed to reduce unnecessary meetings and support work-life balance.

jobs.title: Graduate Software Engineer, Open Source and Linux, Canonical Ubuntu
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Contribute to the design, development, and continuous improvement of open-source software and commercial engineering systems. You will take ownership of meaningful technical challenges while collaborating with globally distributed teams, engaging with users, and developing a deep understanding of Linux and modern software engineering practices. Contribute to product development and help shape engineering roadmaps during global in-person team sprints held twice a year. Design and develop intuitive user experiences, including developer tools, command-line applications, and software interfaces. Write high-quality, reliable, secure, and performant code for products and services potentially used by millions of people worldwide. Develop technical expertise and progressively master key programming languages, software engineering practices, and Linux system technologies. Engage with open-source communities and users through code reviews, issue trackers, and collaborative development activities. Respond to customer issues and technical challenges, prioritizing effective solutions and developing an understanding of enterprise requirements. Apply security-conscious engineering principles throughout software design, development, and implementation. Collaborate with colleagues across different regions and technical disciplines through remote teamwork, pair programming, mentoring, and shared problem-solving. Participate in engineering discussions and contribute ideas that improve product quality, performance, usability, and long-term maintainability. Explore different engineering domains and technologies, potentially including kernels, drivers, cloud computing, containers, Kubernetes, embedded Linux, AI/ML, data science, and distributed systems. Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing within engineering teams and the wider open-source ecosystem. Requirements : The ideal candidate is an academically high-performing graduate with strong programming fundamentals, a genuine passion for open-source technologies, and the motivation to tackle complex engineering challenges. You should demonstrate curiosity, initiative, accountability, and the ability to work independently while contributing effectively to an international engineering team. Bachelor's degree completed or expected in 2026 or 2027 in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Mathematics, or another STEM discipline that includes programming coursework. Exceptional academic performance throughout high school and university, supported by strong results or recognized academic achievements. Confidence in developing and delivering high-quality software using at least one of the following languages: Python, Rust, C, C++, Go, JavaScript, or Java. Practical experience with Ubuntu or another Linux distribution. Personal technology or software engineering projects completed outside academic coursework or professional employment. Strong understanding of programming fundamentals and enthusiasm for learning complex software systems. Excellent written and spoken English. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across international and distributed teams. A results-oriented and organized approach, with the motivation to meet commitments and deliver high-quality outcomes. Curiosity, flexibility, personal accountability, and a willingness to take ownership of responsibilities. Self-awareness, thoughtful decision-making, and the ability to reflect on feedback and continuously improve. Willingness and ability to travel internationally two to four times per year for company events lasting approximately one to two weeks. Nice-to-have qualifications: Previous contributions to upstream open-source projects. Experience with software packaging or Linux distributions such as Debian, Fedora, Arch, or Nix. Leadership, organizational, or team coordination experience. Strong presentation, technical writing, and documentation skills. Interes

jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Build, maintain, and improve backend services and APIs that support the platform. Design, query, and optimise databases to ensure performance, reliability, and effective data management. Collaborate with backend engineers to develop and deliver new product features. Participate in code reviews, providing constructive, direct, and respectful feedback. Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve issues affecting production systems. Contribute to system reliability and help maintain the quality and stability of backend services. Write and update technical documentation to support collaboration across distributed teams. Develop expertise in a chosen product area and take end-to-end ownership of at least one feature or service. Requirements: Solid working knowledge of at least one backend programming language, such as Python or Elixir. Experience developing and working with APIs, including REST or similar technologies. Good understanding of databases, data manipulation, and SQL, ideally with PostgreSQL. Good written and spoken English communication skills. Ability to work effectively with distributed teams across different time zones, using clear written communication and shared documentation. Strong sense of ownership, with a commitment to building and maintaining reliable services. Collaborative approach to engineering, including active participation in technical discussions and code reviews. Ability to deliver an initial version early, incorporate feedback, and continuously improve solutions. Nice to have: Experience with Elixir and the Phoenix framework. Familiarity with cloud services, particularly AWS. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement for candidates based in Europe or Africa (GMT+1). Paid time off (PTO), including one additional PTO day for each year of service. National public holidays applicable in the employee's country. Maternity and paternity leave. Equipment allowance. Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP). Opportunity to work with an international team across multiple countries and time zones. Professional growth through feature ownership and the opportunity to develop deep product expertise.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Role & Responsibilities: Take responsibility for the scalability, stability and availability of our low-latency and mission-critical systems. Enhance the CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions. Generate and maintain Helm manifests for Kubernetes. Maintain our Infrastructure as Code. Set up and maintain monitoring via New Relic, Prometheus and Grafana. Debug infrastructure and detect bottlenecks. Take responsibility for the company-wide tech infrastructure across all environments. Manage VPN, load balancers and firewalls. Take responsibility for high availability and disaster recovery. Implement secure and stable infrastructure. Drive continuous improvement and cost optimization. Take responsibility for 24x7 monitoring, resolving infrastructure-tier incidents and escalating to upper tiers where necessary. Investigate incidents and produce clear incident report documentation. Skills: Excellent understanding of GCP cloud and AWS cloud. Knowledge of containerized environments with Kubernetes and Docker. Ability to develop a well-managed infrastructure setup. Strong hands-on experience building high availability infrastructure using EKS on AWS. Strong understanding of IaC, specifically Terraform. Strong understanding of GitOps , specifically ArgoCD. Strong understanding of securing production infrastructure. Qualifications: Minimum 2 years of experience in DevOps on production applications. Minimum 1 year working with Terraform. Minimum 1 year working with infrastructure monitoring tools. Experience in designing and architecting high performing applications. Experience in agile development practices. Experience in a fast growing startup is a plus. AWS certifications are a plus.

jobs.title: Head of Product - AdTech
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Lead the overall product strategy and development of the AdTech portfolio, identifying opportunities to strengthen mobile advertising capabilities and deliver measurable value to game developers. You will combine strategic leadership, market research, technical expertise, and hands-on product execution to build solutions that support sustainable customer and business growth. Define and own the long-term product vision, strategy, and roadmap across the AdTech business. Identify emerging opportunities in mobile advertising by analyzing customer needs, market trends, competitive developments, technological advancements, and unmet industry demands. Explore how artificial intelligence and automation can transform mobile monetization and user acquisition, making sophisticated advertising solutions accessible to developers of all sizes. Develop an integrated growth ecosystem connecting ad monetization, user acquisition, and data to help game studios make informed decisions and improve profitability. Lead product initiatives from initial concept and validation through development, launch, optimization, and scaling. Establish clear product priorities, balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, commercial opportunities, and long-term business objectives. Collaborate with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to align product investments with strategic business goals. Translate complex advertising technologies into intuitive, scalable products that solve meaningful customer problems. Use data, experimentation, and performance insights to evaluate product success and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Take ownership of measurable customer outcomes, product performance, revenue contribution, and overall business growth. Encourage innovation and experimentation while supporting teams in developing stronger product thinking and execution capabilities. Requirements : We are looking for an experienced and entrepreneurial product leader with a strong background in AdTech, mobile advertising, or performance marketing technology. The ideal candidate combines a comprehensive understanding of the advertising ecosystem with technical curiosity, commercial awareness, and a proven ability to turn complex ideas into successful products. You should be comfortable operating at both strategic and execution levels, influencing senior stakeholders, and helping teams deliver ambitious product initiatives. At least 5 years of experience building, developing, and scaling products in AdTech, mobile advertising, or adjacent performance marketing technology. Deep understanding of the mobile advertising ecosystem, including ad monetization, mediation, user acquisition, demand-side platforms (DSPs), supply-side platforms (SSPs), bidding mechanisms, attribution, and advertising economics. Proven track record of taking complex technical products from concept to launch and delivering measurable commercial results. Experience working with data-intensive platforms, optimization systems, machine learning, or AI-powered products. Strong understanding of customer businesses and the ability to identify problems that create meaningful, measurable value when solved. Excellent commercial judgment, with the ability to connect product decisions to customer outcomes, revenue generation, and business growth. Entrepreneurial mindset and a demonstrated ability to identify opportunities, challenge conventional approaches, and build products from zero to one. Strong strategic vision combined with practical execution skills and sound technical judgment. Customer-focused approach, with the ability to translate market insights and customer needs into effective product strategies. Experience bringing cross-functional teams together, coaching product professionals, and raising standards for product development. Performance-driven attitude, with a willingness to experiment, learn from setbacks, and continuously improve. Excellent communication

jobs.title: Head of Product - AdTech
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Lead the overall product strategy and development of the AdTech portfolio, identifying opportunities to strengthen mobile advertising capabilities and deliver measurable value to game developers. You will combine strategic leadership, market research, technical expertise, and hands-on product execution to build solutions that support sustainable customer and business growth. Define and own the long-term product vision, strategy, and roadmap across the AdTech business. Identify emerging opportunities in mobile advertising by analyzing customer needs, market trends, competitive developments, technological advancements, and unmet industry demands. Explore how artificial intelligence and automation can transform mobile monetization and user acquisition, making sophisticated advertising solutions accessible to developers of all sizes. Develop an integrated growth ecosystem connecting ad monetization, user acquisition, and data to help game studios make informed decisions and improve profitability. Lead product initiatives from initial concept and validation through development, launch, optimization, and scaling. Establish clear product priorities, balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, commercial opportunities, and long-term business objectives. Collaborate with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to align product investments with strategic business goals. Translate complex advertising technologies into intuitive, scalable products that solve meaningful customer problems. Use data, experimentation, and performance insights to evaluate product success and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Take ownership of measurable customer outcomes, product performance, revenue contribution, and overall business growth. Strong understanding of customer businesses and the ability to identify problems that create meaningful, measurable value when solved. jobs.title: Integrated Marketing Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Own the planning and execution of integrated marketing initiatives designed to generate qualified leads, accelerate pipeline development, and support revenue growth. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful campaigns, optimize marketing resources, and demonstrate the commercial value of marketing investments. Design and execute multi-channel demand generation campaigns across email, social media, targeted advertising lists, and other digital channels to attract qualified prospects and generate measurable pipeline. Develop and implement campaign strategies promoting cloud productivity and AI solutions, ensuring alignment with broader go-to-market objectives. Collaborate with internal creative, copywriting, and content teams to develop and deploy compelling marketing assets that communicate product value and support campaign performance. Leverage existing content and marketing resources, adapting and localizing materials to meet campaign requirements and create effective sales enablement collateral. Partner with go-to-market teams to plan and execute promotional strategies for joint events and webinars, maximizing attendance and engagement among high-value prospects. Work with sales teams, customers, and internal content specialists to identify successful customer stories and develop compelling case studies that demonstrate the value of integrated technology solutions. Manage marketing development funds (MDF) compliance by preparing proof-of-performance reports, documenting campaign activities, and maintaining supporting materials required for funding validation. Monitor campaign performance, lead quality, pipeline contribution, and return on investment to assess effectiveness and identify optimization opportunities. Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery of marketing assets, campaign materials, and related activities. Continuously identify opportunities to improve campaign execution, strengthen collaboration, and increase marketing impact. Requirements : We are looking for a results-oriented marketing professional with a strong background in B2B digital marketing, demand generation, and integrated campaign management. The ideal candidate combines analytical thinking, content marketing expertise, and excellent project management skills with the ability to collaborate across teams and translate marketing initiatives into measurable commercial results. At least 5 years of professional experience in B2B digital marketing, demand generation, or campaign management. Demonstrated ability to use content marketing and digital assets to improve lead conversion and contribute to pipeline growth. Strong understanding of multi-channel marketing strategies and demand generation best practices. Data-driven mindset, with a strong focus on tracking campaign performance, lead quality, pipeline contribution, and marketing ROI. Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple campaigns, asset creation processes, content deliveries, and marketing lists simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with sales, creative, content, and go-to-market teams. Ability to develop compelling marketing messages and leverage customer success stories to communicate business value. Experience managing marketing budgets, campaign documentation, and performance reporting is an advantage. Previous experience within a cloud technology partner ecosystem, particularly Google Cloud, Microsoft, or AWS, is preferred. Familiarity with marketing and project management platforms such as HubSpot, Marketo, Google Workspace, Cvent, and Asana is considered a plus. Proactive, adaptable, and commercially minded approach, with a strong commitment to continuous learning and professional development. Benefits : Annual compensation ranging from $90,000 to $110,000, depending on experience and qualifications. Additional

jobs.title: GTM Marketing Manager, Google Cloud
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Lead go-to-market coordination and partner marketing initiatives, ensuring strong alignment between external technology partners and internal commercial teams. You will translate strategic campaigns into actionable sales activities, facilitate collaboration, and deliver targeted programs that accelerate opportunities and strengthen customer relationships. Serve as the primary liaison between the Google corporate sales organization and internal commercial teams, ensuring alignment on joint pipeline objectives and go-to-market priorities. Build and maintain strong relationships across partner and internal sales organizations, facilitating communication and collaboration between different teams and sales structures. Integrate Google Workspace and Gemini messaging into broader go-to-market strategies, helping sales teams develop cohesive solution propositions and communicate combined value to customers. Translate high-level corporate marketing campaigns into targeted, account-specific sales initiatives that support commercial priorities and pipeline development. Coordinate and execute customer-facing activities, including prospective customer meetings, executive roundtables, targeted field events, and high-touch webinars designed to accelerate mid-funnel opportunities. Act as a central point of contact for sales enablement and partner communication, ensuring sellers understand how and when to access partner resources, subject matter experts, and tailored marketing collateral. Facilitate collaboration between sales teams and relevant stakeholders to ensure consistent messaging, effective campaign execution, and strong commercial alignment. Track the performance of field activations, joint marketing initiatives, and sales programs, measuring their contribution to pipeline development and business outcomes. Prepare detailed proof-of-performance reports and activity documentation for partner organizations to demonstrate marketing impact and ensure accountability for marketing development funds (MDF). Identify opportunities to improve partner collaboration, strengthen sales engagement, and increase the effectiveness of go-to-market programs. Requirements : We are looking for a relationship-oriented marketing professional with significant experience in partner, field, or channel marketing, preferably within the B2B technology sector. The ideal candidate combines strong commercial awareness with excellent stakeholder management and execution skills, enabling them to connect different sales organizations and turn strategic marketing objectives into measurable sales activities. At least 5 years of experience in partner marketing, field marketing, or channel marketing. Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex, matrixed organizations and bridge different sales cultures. Proven experience translating corporate marketing strategies and high-level campaigns into practical, account-specific sales initiatives. Experience planning, organizing, and executing targeted customer meetings, field events, executive engagements, and sales activation programs. Strong understanding of B2B marketing strategies and the relationship between partner marketing, sales enablement, and pipeline development. Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and facilitate collaboration between external partners and internal commercial teams. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and maintain productive professional relationships. Strong organizational and project management abilities, including the coordination of events, campaigns, and marketing resources. Analytical mindset and experience tracking marketing program performance, preparing activity reports, and demonstrating return on investment. Previous experience working closely with enterprise B2B technology sales teams or within major cloud partner ecosystems is preferred. Familiarity

jobs.title: Support Systems & Programs Lead
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: The Support Systems & Programs Lead will oversee the people, technology, and processes that support efficient and scalable customer service operations. The role requires strategic ownership of the Support tooling ecosystem, hands-on technical guidance, and strong cross-functional collaboration to improve service quality and operational performance. Lead, coach, and develop Systems and Programs engineers, supporting their technical growth and career progression. Establish clear team responsibilities, planning processes, and delivery rhythms to ensure consistent execution against priorities. Contribute to hiring and onboarding while remaining involved in technical decisions and hands-on problem-solving. Own the Support tooling portfolio and define a prioritised roadmap that enables Reactive and Proactive Support to scale. Establish structured project intake, scoping, and prioritisation processes to focus engineering resources on high-impact initiatives. Collaborate with Support leadership and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Cloud, Security, Legal, Data, Customer Success, Sales, and Partnerships. Lead the expansion of AI-powered Support solutions across different support tiers to increase the proportion of tickets resolved through AI. Guide the development, maintenance, and adoption of reliable automations, AI agents, and integrations that reduce repetitive tasks and improve efficiency. Track the impact of AI and automation through metrics such as time saved, AI-handled ticket share, and cost per AI-handled ticket. Rebuild and optimise foundational Support processes to ensure workflows are efficient, documented, and scalable. Establish governance for standard operating procedures (SOPs), tooling ownership, and automation reliability. Monitor tooling adoption, SOP compliance, operational efficiency, and the capacity freed up for Support teams. Drive continuous improvement across Support systems, processes, and operational foundations. Requirements : The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise in workflow automation and SaaS systems, combined with proven engineering leadership experience. They should be comfortable translating operational challenges into technical roadmaps, implementing AI-powered solutions, and aligning stakeholders around shared priorities. Practical experience building complex workflows with n8n is essential. Hands-on experience building and maintaining complex workflows and automations using n8n. Strong technical foundations, including APIs, HTTP, authentication, webhooks, and SaaS architecture. Proven experience owning and improving technical Support systems, tooling, and automations in a B2B SaaS environment. At least 5 years of experience leading or mentoring engineers, supporting their development, and ensuring high-quality delivery. Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into clear technical priorities and manage a technical roadmap. Experience implementing AI agents or AI-assisted Support tools to improve operational efficiency. Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams. Experience as a developer, in DevOps, or working on an automation-focused technical product is an advantage. Familiarity with Support performance metrics and analytics or dashboarding tools such as Hex or Metabase is a plus. Experience in open-source or community-led SaaS environments is beneficial. Previous experience working in distributed, remote-first teams, ideally within a European startup or scale-up, is desirable. Strong coaching, communication, prioritisation, and problem-solving skills. Ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on technical involvement and operational ownership. Professional proficiency in English, the organisation's working language. Must have existing legal authorisation to work in the United Kingdom, as visa sponsorship is available for Germany only. Benefits : Competitive compensation. Equity participa

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Identification & JS Agent
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As Technical Product Manager, you will coordinate the delivery of assigned product features and initiatives while ensuring that requirements, documentation, dependencies, and stakeholder communications remain clear and up to date. You will work alongside senior product leadership and technical teams to support execution, gather insights, prepare launches, and monitor product performance. Product Delivery & Execution Own delivery coordination for assigned product features, epics, and workstreams within the priorities and constraints established by the Senior Technical Product Manager. Translate product direction into actionable user stories, jobs-to-be-done (JTBD), acceptance criteria, and definitions of done. Maintain Jira epics, tasks, acceptance criteria, and delivery updates in collaboration with Engineering. Keep product systems and records accurate and current, including Notion, Jira, Productboard, and relevant roadmap and release tracking tools. Support backlog refinement, sprint planning readiness, delivery sequencing, and release preparation. Track delivery risks, dependencies, unresolved questions, and key decisions, escalating issues when they affect business objectives, customer commitments, timelines, scope, pricing, eligibility, or strategic priorities. Participate in technical reviews and develop sufficient technical understanding to contribute to discussions about architecture, implementation, and trade-offs. Product Documentation & Communication Create and maintain clear feature documentation under the guidance of senior product leadership. Document product use cases and confidently explain assigned features to internal stakeholders. Support Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) by preparing user stories, JTBD, acceptance criteria, and relevant customer and business context. Draft or contribute to internal release notes, product updates, and stakeholder communications. Ensure developer documentation is updated whenever product behavior or functionality changes. Communicate feature progress, known limitations, delivery timelines, and release readiness to relevant internal teams. Customer, Market & Product Insights Monitor customer feedback, support channels, Productboard insights, and requests from internal stakeholders. Identify recurring issues and potential product limitations or improvement opportunities. Participate in customer discovery activities, brainstorming sessions, user experience discussions, and product feedback reviews. Gather qualitative and quantitative insights to support product prioritization and decision-making. Monitor the competitive landscape and stay informed about relevant technical developments and market trends within assigned product areas. Product Operations & Launch Support Maintain roadmap and feature records as initiatives progress through their lifecycle. Coordinate launch readiness across Engineering, Product Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, and Support. Support Product Marketing in preparing customer education materials, release communications, and launch documentation. Prepare product updates for internal forums, including Customer Success and Sales Engineering meetings and release communication channels. Track post-launch success metrics for assigned epics and issues and summarize findings to inform future product improvements. Requirements : The ideal candidate has experience in product management, product ownership, business analysis, technical program management, or a related role involving technical products. You should be comfortable working with APIs, SaaS platforms, developer tools, security, fraud prevention, or analytics solutions. Strong documentation skills, technical curiosity, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate cross-functional delivery are essential. You should also be motivated to learn product strategy through hands-on execution and take ownership of making complex or ambiguous work clear and actionable. Experience in pr

jobs.title: Contract Recruiter
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: The Contract Recruiter will manage end-to-end recruitment activities for clinical educator network projects, ensuring candidates are identified, assessed, and progressed efficiently while supporting evolving business and geographic staffing needs. Post open positions across relevant recruitment channels and sourcing platforms. Identify, source, screen, and interview candidates in line with project requirements. Coordinate second-level interviews with relevant stakeholders when required. Initiate the contracting process for the most qualified candidates. Manage candidate records and recruitment progress within the applicant tracking system (ATS). Track applicants throughout the recruitment lifecycle and maintain accurate internal recruitment reports and tracking documents. Collaborate with business teams to identify geographic coverage gaps and additional talent requirements. Proactively develop solutions to address talent shortages and recruitment challenges. jobs.title: Creative & Community Lead
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Take ownership of the brand's overall narrative, ensuring that its communication remains consistent, authentic, and relevant across all audience touchpoints. You will combine community insights, strategic planning, creative development, and direct execution to build meaningful engagement and strengthen brand perception. Monitor customer sentiment and public perception through community discussions, CS2 conversations, customer support feedback, Product insights, and business intelligence. Identify what audiences appreciate, what concerns them, and how their perceptions evolve over time. Collaborate with management and Product teams to translate business direction and product developments into a clear, compelling brand narrative. Ensure consistency across social media, blogs, product communications, community interactions, and larger content initiatives while adapting messaging to different audiences. Develop and manage content plans aligned with product roadmaps, events, releases, and developments within the CS2 and esports communities. Create engaging content concepts, including gaming-related productions, community-focused initiatives, collaborations, short-form videos, and larger creative projects. Maximize the value of content production by repurposing collaborations, shoots, and creative assets into multiple deliverables. Direct designers, editors, copywriters, creators, and external production partners, providing clear briefs, feedback, and creative guidance. Take responsibility for the quality and final delivery of creative projects while remaining actively involved in execution. Maintain an authentic and continuous presence within the community, ensuring communication feels natural, relevant, and genuinely engaged rather than limited to promotional announcements. Manage creative resources and production budgets thoughtfully, balancing quality, impact, and commercial efficiency. Requirements : We are looking for a proactive, independent, and highly creative professional with strong storytelling abilities and the confidence to take ownership of both strategy and execution. The ideal candidate combines excellent communication skills, emotional intelligence, audience awareness, and commercial judgment with the ability to lead creative projects and collaborate effectively across different teams. Demonstrated ability to take initiative, work independently, and deliver results without requiring constant direction or extensive team support. Strong creative thinking and storytelling skills, with the ability to develop compelling narratives and translate ideas into engaging content. Hands-on approach, with the ability to contribute directly to content creation and execution rather than relying entirely on others. High emotional intelligence and a strong understanding of psychology, audience behavior, and brand perception. Curiosity and research skills, with a genuine interest in understanding what communities are discussing, appreciating, and criticizing. Strong organizational and project management abilities, including content planning, prioritization, and execution. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with management, Product, Customer Relations, BI, and creative professionals. Experience directing creative work, briefing collaborators, providing constructive feedback, and maintaining high-quality output. Commercial awareness and the ability to manage production, collaboration, and external contractor costs efficiently. Familiarity with CS2, esports, gaming, and internet culture is highly desirable, along with the ability to become deeply immersed in these communities quickly. Benefits : Opportunity to take ownership of the brand's creative direction, storytelling, and community presence. A hands-on, high-impact role combining strategic responsibility with creative execution. Direct collaboration with management, Product teams, and creative professionals. Opp

jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As a Treasury Analyst, you will manage and support essential treasury activities, ensuring financial accuracy, effective liquidity management, and compliance across domestic and international operations. You will collaborate with treasury and accounting teams, maintain banking relationships, and deliver financial analysis that supports operational efficiency and informed decision-making. Prepare daily cash positioning reports within the Treasury Management System (TMS) to support global liquidity management. Monitor and reconcile cash-related accounts, including bank accounts, cash held in kiosks, and cash in transit. Perform regular bank reconciliations to ensure transactions are accurately recorded and consistent with accounting records. Investigate and resolve discrepancies and variances across financial accounts. Prepare reconciliation reports and provide supporting documentation to the accounting team during monthly closing processes. Manage banking relationships and administer domestic and international bank accounts. Liaise with financial institutions to obtain bank statements, transaction reports, and updates on cash positions. Monitor fund disbursements and ensure income and expenditure are recorded in accordance with internal procedures and applicable international accounting standards. Maintain accurate and comprehensive treasury records for all financial transactions. You will combine statistical analysis, commercial insights, and scenario planning to anticipate changes in demand, communicate risks and opportunities, and support the organization's monthly consensus and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) processes. Build, validate, and publish monthly demand forecasts in Anaplan for an assigned portfolio of customers and SKUs, covering baseline demand, promotional activity, new product launches, and product phase-outs. Review statistical forecasts each cycle, apply appropriate overrides, document the rationale, and maintain disciplined forecasting practices. Develop and compare forecast scenarios to assess risks and opportunities related to promotions, supply constraints, pricing changes, and other business developments. Monitor forecast accuracy and bias, investigate variances, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions. Develop launch forecasts for new products using historical analogs, marketing plans, and customer-level merchandising assumptions, then track performance against expected growth. Represent the assigned portfolio in consensus forecasting and S&OP meetings, presenting forecast changes, underlying assumptions, risks, and opportunities to Sales, Revenue Growth Management, and Finance. Gather and challenge assumptions related to promotions, product launches and discontinuations, distribution changes, pricing, and customer-specific plans. Identify and communicate demand risks and opportunities early enough to support proactive business decisions. Partner with Supply Planning to monitor inventory levels, weeks of supply, fill-rate risks, and allocation decisions, identifying potential demand and supply imbalances. Analyze retailer and channel trends using internal, point-of-sale (POS), and syndicated data to understand customer ordering behavior. Contribute demand inputs and scenario analysis to annual operating plans and long-range planning activities in collaboration with Finance and Commercial teams. Support the Anaplan implementation through user acceptance testing, data validation, and the migration of assigned accounts from Excel-based processes. Work with the Demand Planning Analyst to maintain master data accuracy, support reporting requirements, and investigate data issues affecting forecasts. Follow demand review calendars and forecast lock dates while keeping portfolio assumptions up to date between planning cycles. Identify opportunities to improve planning processes, reduce manual work, and strengthen forecasting reliability. Requirements : The ideal candidate brings 5–8 years of professional supply chain experience, including at least 1–2 years in demand planning or a closely related role. You should have experience managing a customer or category portfolio through a complete monthly forecasting cycle, strong analytical capabilities, and the confidence to explain and defend planning assumptions. Success in this role requires both technical proficiency and the ability to influence stakeholders across commercial and operational teams. 5–8 years of professional supply chain experience, with at least 1–2 years as a Demand Planner, Demand Planning Analyst, or in an equivalent position. Experience owning a customer or category portfolio through a full monthly demand forecasting cycle. Experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP system for managing order, shipment, and inventory history. Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, and the ability to manage and analyze large datasets. jobs.title: Quality Manager, Vendor Compliance
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As Quality Manager, Vendor Compliance, you will take ownership of supplier quality programs and the systems used to maintain food safety, regulatory compliance, and reliable manufacturing standards. You will work across internal teams and external partners to identify risks, resolve quality issues, strengthen supplier performance, and ensure documentation remains accurate and audit-ready. Supplier Quality & Compliance Own supplier qualification, approval, and compliance programs, ensuring suppliers and materials meet quality, food safety, regulatory, and business requirements. Lead supplier and material onboarding in partnership with Procurement, Regulatory, R&D, and Supply Chain. Establish and maintain risk-based supplier and ingredient assessments based on material risk, manufacturing processes, supplier performance, and historical quality data. Lead supplier quality investigations, corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and escalations, ensuring root causes are identified and corrective actions are sustainable. Ensure suppliers comply with established requirements, including supplier expectation guidelines, specifications, quality standards, and applicable regulations. Lead supplier audits and facility assessments while driving continuous improvement through effective supplier partnerships. Ingredient Quality Management Manage the ingredient positive release program, including certificate of analysis (COA) reviews, material disposition, and communication with warehouses and internal stakeholders. Establish risk-based ingredient testing and verification programs to confirm materials meet quality and food safety specifications. Oversee ingredient retention sample and traceability programs to support investigations and supplier performance evaluations. Lead ingredient nonconformance investigations and coordinate appropriate supplier corrective actions and material disposition. Monitor ingredient quality trends and variability to identify and mitigate emerging risks. Quality Systems & Document Control Own document control processes for Quality and Supply Chain documentation, including SOPs, forms, specifications, and work instructions. Establish standards for document creation, review, approval, version control, archiving, and retention. Ensure supplier compliance records remain complete, current, and audit-ready. Coordinate periodic document reviews with cross-functional process owners to ensure procedures reflect current practices and requirements. Continuously improve quality systems and documentation processes to strengthen compliance, traceability, and operational efficiency. Supplier Performance & Continuous Improvement Develop and manage supplier performance metrics and scorecards to track quality, compliance, recurring issues, and emerging risks. Establish supplier performance review and escalation processes, including improvement plans for high-risk or underperforming suppliers. Analyze supplier and ingredient quality trends to identify systemic risks and improvement opportunities. Partner with Procurement and Supply Chain leadership on supplier approval, performance management, escalation, and disqualification decisions. Provide leadership with visibility into supplier quality risks, significant nonconformances, and outstanding corrective actions. Requirements : The ideal candidate has 6–8+ years of Quality Assurance or Supplier Quality experience in the food and beverage industry, preferably within beverage manufacturing. You bring strong technical knowledge of food safety systems and supplier compliance, combined with the ability to manage investigations, audits, and corrective action programs. You are analytical, organized, and comfortable influencing external suppliers and internal stakeholders while managing competing priorities. 6–8+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Supplier Quality within the food and beverage industry; beverage experience is preferred. 0–2 years of experience

jobs.title: FP&A AI Research Contributor
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Leverage your FP&A expertise to develop realistic, practical tasks that replicate the responsibilities and challenges of financial planning and analysis professionals. Work through each assignment to establish accurate expected outcomes and create objective evaluation criteria that can be used to assess AI-generated results. Develop realistic FP&A tasks based on your professional experience and everyday financial workflows. Create domain-specific assignments and deliverables using Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and other relevant professional tools. Complete each task independently to establish a clear, accurate, and reliable reference answer. Identify common mistakes and limitations in AI-generated financial analysis and incorporate relevant scenarios into evaluation tasks. Develop precise yes-or-no evaluation criteria that allow graders to consistently assess the accuracy and quality of AI-generated outputs. Follow provided project guidelines and collaborate with the research team to ensure tasks meet quality expectations. Apply attention to detail and professional judgment throughout the task creation and evaluation process. Requirements: The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in financial planning and analysis, with a strong understanding of financial workflows and the ability to translate professional knowledge into structured, practical assignments. You should be comfortable producing and reviewing financial deliverables, communicating clearly in English, and exploring how AI tools can support or improve finance-related activities. Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A). Relevant professional qualifications are valued, including ACCA, CIMA, CPA, CA, or ACA. Strong written English communication skills and the ability to explain complex financial concepts clearly. Practical experience using financial tools and producing professional deliverables in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and gaps in financial outputs. Willingness to learn about artificial intelligence, AI evaluation methodologies, and emerging concepts in AI assessments. Ability to develop structured tasks and objective evaluation criteria. Familiarity with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems is an advantage. Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and deliver high-quality assignments within the required timelines. Benefits: Fully remote independent contractor opportunity. Flexible working schedule, allowing you to complete tasks on your own schedule. Immediate start available. Initial project duration of approximately 4–6 weeks. Task-based compensation, with payment issued weekly following task completion. Opportunity to qualify for additional assignments throughout the project after successfully completing the first task within the required timeline. Potential for project extensions depending on business needs and individual performance. Opportunity to apply your FP&A expertise to real-world AI training and evaluation initiatives. Exposure to emerging AI technologies and professional AI assessment methodologies. No requirement to access confidential or proprietary information belonging to current or previous employers, clients, or institutions.

jobs.title: Data QA Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Translate customer data extraction and web scraping requirements into clear, measurable testing strategies, taking ownership of quality assurance from the beginning of new projects. Design and execute comprehensive test plans combining exploratory, manual, visual, and automated testing approaches according to project needs. Perform regular testing cycles on extracted datasets to validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability. Identify, investigate, document, and report defects with clear reproduction steps and sufficient technical detail to enable developers to resolve issues efficiently. Apply descriptive statistics, data summaries, and visualizations to assess data quality, identify anomalies, and monitor potential data drift. Prepare detailed test reports and quality scores, providing internal stakeholders and customers with an accurate understanding of project quality and potential risks. Clearly communicate testing coverage, limitations, unresolved issues, and remaining risks throughout the delivery process. Collaborate with project managers and customers to clarify requirements, identify ambiguities, and ensure that expectations are measurable and testable before QA activities begin. Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of test automation frameworks, focusing on test coverage, reliability, and performance. Identify and implement improvements to QA processes and tools, including browser extensions, spreadsheet add-ons, and user-interface-based testing solutions. Work closely with QA leadership, developers, and project managers to maintain high-quality standards while operating with a high degree of independence. Requirements: At least 5 years of professional experience as a QA Engineer or in a comparable quality assurance role, preferably involving software testing, data validation, or data quality. Strong Python programming skills, ideally with practical experience using Pandas and Jupyter Notebook for data analysis, processing, and validation. Basic to intermediate SQL knowledge, with the ability to write queries and work confidently with at least one relational database and its associated tools. Solid understanding of web technologies and protocols, including HTML, XPath, JSON, HTTP, and CSS. Practical experience designing and executing tests for HTTP and REST APIs. Strong knowledge of test case design, test planning, test execution, and test data management. Understanding of key data quality concepts, including completeness, accuracy, consistency, reliability, and data drift. Experience working in Agile development environments, including Scrum or Kanban, and collaborating closely with software developers. Familiarity with AI and Large Language Model (LLM) tools, particularly their application in generating test cases, accelerating data validation, and improving QA workflows. Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, combined with strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to quality ownership. Ability to quickly understand complex project requirements, learn new technologies, and adapt to changing priorities. Confidence in maintaining high-quality standards and raising concerns when delivery timelines or project pressures could compromise quality. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Nice to Have: Working knowledge of Scrapy and other Python-based web scraping frameworks. Previous experience developing or working with test automation frameworks. Interest or experience in data science concepts, particularly as applied to data analysis, interpretation, and validation. Enthusiasm for exploring AI and LLM-powered tools to improve testing efficiency and accelerate data quality assessments. Benefits: Fully Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom and flexibility to work from anywhere in the world, choosing the environment where you are most productive. jobs.title: Senior Game Scout
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Identify and source high-potential PC and console games through established industry networks, gaming events, developer relationships, and digital platforms, with an initial focus on Steam and Epic Games Store. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of publishing opportunities by developing relationships with independent developers, game studios, and key industry stakeholders. Evaluate the creative, technical, and commercial potential of games, assessing gameplay mechanics, core loops, depth, replayability, accessibility, audience appeal, differentiation, and competitive positioning. Analyze market opportunities and assess a game's potential for streaming, content creation, community engagement, and long-term commercial success. Evaluate development teams, production capabilities, budgets, timelines, financial projections, and potential risks to determine the feasibility of publishing opportunities. Review pitches, prototypes, and playable builds, preparing structured assessments and presenting well-supported recommendations to internal stakeholders. Coordinate due diligence and lead or support commercial negotiations with prospective publishing partners, maintaining strong relationships throughout the evaluation and signing process. Establish and improve scouting processes, evaluation frameworks, pipeline management systems, and performance standards to support the growth of the publishing function. Monitor PC and console gaming trends, emerging genres, market developments, and competitive activity to identify new publishing opportunities. Report on potential signings, communicate pipeline progress, and contribute to recruiting and developing the scouting team as the business expands. Requirements: Significant professional experience in PC and console publishing, game scouting, business development, or a related commercial role. A proactive, performance-driven mindset, with a strong focus on impact, experimentation, continuous improvement, and measurable results. jobs.title: Procurement Lead
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Own end-to-end relationships with key cloud and SaaS vendors, including AWS, GCP, Cloudflare, CloudQuery, ClickHouse, and other strategic partners, leading contract negotiations and renewals in collaboration with Finance and Legal. Establish and enforce procurement governance, including competitive bidding processes, approval thresholds, benchmarking, and coordination with managed-procurement partners. Lead the Procurement and FinOps function, defining its operating model, roadmap, processes, and standards while ensuring alignment with wider business objectives. Manage and develop direct reports by overseeing onboarding, performance management, career development, regular one-to-ones, and day-to-day team administration. Drive the team's delivery and accountability through roadmap management, project tracking, workflow prioritization, and stakeholder communication. Improve commercial visibility and unit economics by monitoring vendor expenditure, identifying licensing inefficiencies, analyzing usage patterns, and driving renewals, right-sizing, and tooling consolidation to achieve measurable savings. Build and maintain vendor and SaaS cost dashboards and reporting systems, working hands-on with data and partnering with internal teams to scale reporting capabilities. Define and maintain spending policies, governance frameworks, accountability standards, and cost-control thresholds. Coordinate cloud cost-efficiency initiatives, tracking optimization opportunities from initial commitment through to realized savings in partnership with Engineering teams. Requirements: At least 8 years of experience in procurement, vendor or commercial management, FinOps, or technical and financial analysis, including senior-level ownership of a function or strategic area. Proven experience managing strategic vendor relationships, negotiating commercial agreements, and overseeing contract renewals. Strong understanding of procurement governance, including competitive bidding, contract benchmarking, approval processes, and managed-procurement partnerships. Hands-on experience building cost dashboards and reporting solutions using SQL, business intelligence tools, or similar analytical technologies. Comfortable analyzing cloud infrastructure expenditure, particularly AWS and GCP costs, SaaS billing, licensing structures, and usage data. Strong financial and analytical capabilities, with the ability to translate complex spending information into actionable insights and measurable business outcomes. Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical teams. Strong judgment, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence decisions, build consensus, and drive alignment without relying on formal authority. Experience working in asynchronous, remote-first, or globally distributed organizations. Proven ability to build processes and functions from the ground up, take ownership, and navigate ambiguity in fast-moving environments. Demonstrated people-management skills, including team development, performance management, and fostering a high-trust working culture. Benefits: Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world, with a WeWork membership or co-working allowance to support your preferred working environment. Equity Ownership (ESOP): Receive company equity, allowing you to share in the organization's long-term growth and success. Technology Allowance: Access a dedicated budget to equip your workspace with the technology and tools you need to perform at your best. Health Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance coverage, with 100% of employee premiums and 80% of dependent premiums covered, regardless of location. Annual Company Off-Sites: Join colleagues from around the world for a week-long annual gathering focused on collaboration, connection, and team building. Transform alerts, runbooks, and manual operational procedures into more reliable software, automation, and improved monitoring. Own service-level objectives for assigned customers, tracking performance against contractual SLAs and reporting results monthly. Investigate issues across codebases owned by different component teams, identify root causes, and drive engineering fixes through to completion. Support the evolution of production operations so that additional institutional customers can be onboarded without proportionally increasing operational headcount. jobs.title: Vehicle Inspection Specialist
jobs.description: Job Title: Vehicle Inspection Specialist Employment Type: Full-time, On-site Location: Soum Car Showroom, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Department: Operations Language Requirement: Fluent in Arabic Role Overview Every car Soum hands over carries our name, so its condition has to be exactly what we promised. The Vehicle Inspection Specialist owns the technical truth about each vehicle: you inspect it when it first comes in, identify and document any damage or defects, carry out the final inspection before handover, and assess technical issues raised after the sale. You also support the Cars Operations team with day-to-day operational tasks. This is a technical role, not a customer-facing one. The After-Sales Customer Experience Specialist owns all customer communication, complaints, and follow-ups. You give them accurate, clearly documented findings so they can keep the customer informed and resolve the case. The goal of the role: no car leaves the showroom with an undocumented defect, every inspection report is accurate and complete, and technical issues are diagnosed quickly and routed to the right fix. Duties & Responsibilities: Vehicle Handover Schedule handover appointments with customers and confirm the time, location, and documents they need to bring. Before each appointment, confirm that the car has passed its pre-handover check and that all accessories are present: keys, manual, and spare tyre. Walk the customer through the car's condition and inspection report, and introduce its key features. Sign the handover form with the customer and document it with photos. Vehicle Inspection & Condition Assessment Conduct the initial inspection of every vehicle, covering the body, exterior, interior, and overall condition, against Soum's approved inspection checklist. Assess mechanical and electrical components, including the engine, transmission, suspension, brakes, steering, and electrical systems. Identify and report any damage, defects, previous repairs, issues, or discrepancies against what was listed or agreed with the buyer. Assess the overall condition of each vehicle and record it consistently, so that condition ratings mean the same thing across every car. Inspection Reports & Documentation Produce a clear, accurate inspection report for every vehicle inspected, written so that a non-technical colleague can explain it to a customer. Take photographs of each vehicle's condition and of every defect found, and attach them to the report. Record all findings, reports, and photos in the system so they are available to Sales and After-Sales. Keep inspection records complete and up to date, so the condition of any vehicle at any stage can be verified. Pre-Handover Checks Conduct the final inspection before vehicle handover or completion, confirming the car matches its inspection report and has not changed in condition since it was listed. Verify that every car is complete with all accessories: keys, manual, and spare tyre. Confirm that the car is ready, or flag what must be fixed before the handover appointment. Post-Sale Technical Issues & Escalation Assess technical issues raised in post-sale warranty requests and complaints, using the case details passed on by the After-Sales CX Specialist. Determine the likely cause, whether the issue was present at handover, and the recommended fix. Document your technical findings in the case so the After-Sales CX Specialist can update the customer. Escalate technical issues outside your authority in line with approved procedures. Workshops & Cars Operations Brief approved maintenance workshops on the technical findings and the work required. Review completed repairs and confirm the issue has been fixed before the case is closed. Feed recurring defects and post-sale technical complaints back into the inspection checklist to improve future inspections. jobs.title: Senior Crude Oil Analyst
jobs.description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. About the Role As a Senior Crude Oil Research Analyst based in Dubai, you will serve as Kpler’s regional market authority on Middle Eastern physical crude dynamics, focusing on refinery activity, product yields, and downstream trade flows. Operating at the crossroads of physical cargo tracking and fundamental market analysis, you will translate complex refinery runs and crude movements into clear, actionable intelligence. In this high-impact individual contributor role, your insights will directly empower global commodity traders and market participants to navigate physical trading, arbitrage, and downstream market shifts with confidence. Key Responsibilities:: Deliver in-depth market intelligence: Conduct rigorous research on Middle Eastern physical crude and refined product markets, focusing on refinery runs, crude throughput, planned maintenance, and physical trade flows . Advance supply, demand, and refinery modeling: Maintain and refine proprietary supply-demand and refinery activity models, ensuring high data integrity compared against international benchmarks such as JODI, EIA, and IEA . Strengthen OSP advisory capabilities: Spearhead analysis and client-facing insights around Middle Eastern Official Selling Prices (OSPs), pricing mechanisms, and crude grade differentials . Publish timely market commentary: Author high-quality research reports, concise market briefs, and ad-hoc commentary highlighting Kpler’s proprietary cargo and inventory data for global clients . Represent Kpler across the industry: Present regional market insights during client briefings, industry webinars, and specialist media engagements to expand Kpler’s thought leadership across the Middle East . Drive commercial and product innovation: Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Product Engineering teams to support pre-sales discussions, demonstrate data value, and co-develop next-generation analytics offerings . Experience & Background:: 5+ years of prior professional experience analysing crude oil markets, with deep familiarity with refinery operations, trading dynamics, and physical trade flows . Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical discipline (Economics, Finance, Engineering, Statistics, or Energy Management) . Proven track record of independently researching, analysing, and writing clear, data-driven market commentary and insights . Strong data analytics and quantitative skills, with demonstrated experience manipulating complex datasets to assess supply, demand, and refinery margins . Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to convey technical market context to clients, media, and cross-functional teams . Nice-to-haves: Practical experience using Kpler cargo-tracking data, AIS platforms, or similar energy intelligence tools . Working familiarity with data querying and analytical tools such as SQL, Python, or R . Direct familiarity with Middle Eastern crude pricing benchmarks, national oil company (NOC) pricing structures, and regional refinery configurations .

jobs.title: AI Voice Recording Contributor - Arabic (Gulf)

jobs.description: We are looking for AIVoice Recording Contributors to join an Arabic (Gulf) voice evaluation project and help support the development of the next generation of AI technologies. Job Type: Freelance Location: Work from home Work Schedule:Flexible, task-based work (approximately 4–6 hours per day) Project Duration: Approximately 1 month Start Date: Immediately Rate: 6 USD/hour Help Shape the Future of AI This short project offers an opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of speech and language AI technologies by providing high-quality voice recordings in your native language and dialect. You will complete recording tasks using our internal platform by reading provided text prompts aloud. The goal is to capture natural speech from native speakers of specific language variants to help improve AI systems' ability to understand diverse languages, dialects, and accents. How Your Recordings Will Be Used Your recordings will be used to evaluate how agents respond to spoken instructions and to compare that evaluation with an evaluation of text-based instructions. The collected audio may be reviewed for quality and incorporated into datasets used for research, development, testing, and improvement of AI systems. What You’ll Do: Read provided text cards aloud and record them exactly as written (there approximately 640 cards per person). Produce clear, natural, and high-quality speech recordings following the guidelines and instructions provided. Speak using your natural dialect and accent. Ensure no words are added, omitted, or altered. Re-record submissions if requested to meet quality standards. Complete tasks using our internal recording platform. What We’re Looking For: Native-level fluency in Arabic (Gulf). Authentic pronunciation and strong familiarity with the target dialect or accent through everyday use. Advanced level of English to understand written instructions. Ability to complete a trial voice recording to verify language variant and accent. Contributors must not imitate dialects or accents that are not their own. Experience with speech recording projects is an advantage, but not required. Strong communication skills and attention to detail. Ability to follow detailed instructions and maintain recording accuracy. Technical Requirements: Quiet room or recording space with minimal background noise. Computer microphone or headset with microphone. Reliable internet connection. Ability to access and use an online recording platform. What We Offer: Flexible, remote work. Timely and reliable payments. Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI technology. Access to future language and AI-related projects. A flexible engagement ideal for gaining experience with AI data collection projects.

jobs.title: Consumer Product Manager
jobs.description: About Soum Soum is a fast-growing B2C marketplace based in Riyadh, connecting buyers and sellers of used electronics and used cars across Saudi Arabia through our website and mobile app. Everything we do is built on trust: buyers need confidence in what they are getting, and sellers need confidence they will be paid fairly and quickly. With the recent launch of our subscription model for electronics and cars, Soum is building the go-to recommerce platform in the Kingdom. About the Role The Consumer Product Manager owns the experience our customers touch every day: how buyers discover, evaluate, pay for and receive a used phone or car, and how sellers list, price and get paid for what they sell. You will be the voice of the Soum customer inside the product team, turning deep consumer insight into features that grow conversion, repeat purchase and trust in the platform. You will work across the app and web, partnering with design, engineering, operations and commercial teams to ship quickly and learn from what we ship. Key Responsibilities: Own the roadmap for a core consumer area (such as the buyer journey, the seller journey or subscriptions), prioritising ruthlessly by impact on conversion, retention, GMV and customer trust. Build a deep, continuous understanding of Soum's customers through user interviews, usability testing, app reviews, customer support tickets and behavioural data. Optimise the end-to-end marketplace funnel: listing creation, search and discovery, product pages, checkout and payments (Mada, Apple Pay, BNPL), delivery tracking, returns and post-purchase experience. Design and improve trust features that make buying used feel safe, including device condition grading, car inspection reports, verified sellers, buyer protection, ratings and transparent pricing. Shape the subscription products for electronics and cars: the value proposition, packaging, onboarding, engagement and retention, working closely with Commercial and Finance on unit economics. Translate problems into clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and run agile delivery with design and engineering, from discovery through release and iteration. Champion an Arabic-first, bilingual experience with high-quality RTL design and localisation for Saudi customers. Run a disciplined experimentation practice: form hypotheses, design A/B tests, define success metrics and make fast, evidence-based decisions on what to scale or kill. Monitor and report on core consumer KPIs, including conversion rate, listing-to-sale rate, activation, repeat purchase, subscription retention, NPS and customer complaints. Partner cross-functionally with Operations (inspection, logistics, customer service), Marketing and Growth (acquisition, CRM), and Finance to make sure product changes work end to end, not just on screen. Keep a close eye on regional and global marketplaces and recommerce players, and bring the best ideas back to Soum, adapted for our customers. Requirements: 2–4 years of product management experience on consumer-facing digital products such as marketplaces, e-commerce, fintech or consumer apps. A proven track record of shipping consumer features that moved measurable business metrics, and the ability to explain exactly how. Strong consumer intuition backed by data: comfortable with product analytics tools (e.g. Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4), funnel analysis and A/B testing; working SQL is a strong plus. Hands-on experience building for mobile (iOS and Android) and web. Solid understanding of two-sided marketplace dynamics, including supply and demand balance, liquidity, trust and pricing. Experience working closely with designers and engineers in an agile environment, with clear written specs and sharp prioritisation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management, able to align operations, commercial and tech teams around a decision. A true owner who moves fast, takes decisions with incomplete information and cares more about outcomes than output.
